title: AI Associate - m/f/d
description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role 

This is a full-time, 12-month program at our Berlin HQ for people who want to understand AI rather than just use it.

It begins where our product meets the real world: customer support. Many support tickets are a small puzzle about how large language models and cloud software behave in production. Why did the same prompt give two different answers? Why did a long document get cut off? Why is one model fast today and slow tomorrow? Why did an agent call the wrong tool? Why did an API integration time out? You will be the person who works out what is actually going on and explains it clearly.

For most of your first year, the support queue is your home base and your classroom. Few jobs expose you to as many real AI systems, real enterprise environments, and real failure modes, every single day.

The purpose of the year: by month twelve, you should understand our platform and operations deeply, from the chat interface down to the models and infrastructure behind it. A Langdock business team should want to hire you permanently, and you should have found the work that energizes you most.

What You Will Learn to Understand 

Customers ask the questions that the rest of the world is still figuring out. To answer them, you will build real intuition for:

- How LLMs actually behave : tokens and context windows, sampling and non-determinism, hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, system prompts, and why models from different providers react differently to the same input.

- Agents, tools, and retrieval : how agents plan and call tools, how knowledge bases and document search feed context to a model, and where these chains tend to break.

- Cloud software in production : APIs, authentication and SSO, rate limits, latency, integrations, multi-tenant enterprise setups, data residency, and access control.

- Inference and compute : what happens when a request hits a model, why throughput, latency, and cost trade off against each other, and how running our own inference changes what we can offer customers.

- Daily operational tasks : resolving billing issues, reporting bugs and being the point of for our customers.

You do not need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who cannot stop asking why until you do.

How the Year Works 

Onboarding: Learn the platform by supporting it. You go through an intensive onboarding into our products, the underlying models, and the support queue. You shadow your first tickets, get to know our systems, and start resolving real customer issues. Expect plenty of experimenting, plenty of questions, and a steep learning curve.

Post-Onboarding: Own the queue and take on sidequests. Alongside the queue, you start picking up work from other teams: tasks below the threshold for a specialist to own but too valuable for your learning to ignore. This includes taking a sales call for a new lead, running a short customer workshop, building customer use cases, writing internal documentation, building internal agents, and further building out our own AI support tooling. As our inference and cloud offering grows, you will increasingly help customers understand and adopt it.

What You Will Do 

- Front-line customer support. Spend most of your day in the queue, handling customer tickets end-to-end across model behavior, API integrations, enterprise compliance, billing, and access control.

- Investigate what is happening under the hood. Reproduce issues, compare model behavior, read logs and API responses, and separate "the model did something unexpected" from "the system did something wrong." Then give users clear, empathetic, and accurate answers.

- Explain AI to the people who use it. Help customers understand non-determinism, model limits, context handling, latency, and model choice in plain language, so they can use AI with confidence.

- Take on cross-team sidequests. Pick up the real work that falls between teams, like a small inbound sales call, a customer workshop, a piece of documentation, or an internal automation. These tasks are small in scope, but you fully own them.

- Escalate to engineering and product. Flag recurring user friction, document edge cases with clear reproduction steps, and report bugs directly to the engineers building our platform and infrastructure.

- Improve support with AI. Propose practical improvements to our support workflow and build and test the internal AI tooling that helps resolve routine questions faster.

What Graduation Looks Like 

You start on a 12-month fixed-term contract. The program is designed so that strong performance turns into a permanent contract in a business department that suits your strengths: AI Adoption Management, Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Recruiting, RevOps, Operations, Solutions Engineering, or elsewhere in the Business team.

We are expanding fast in two directions: across the work people do , with chat, agents, meetings, code, and apps; and down the stack , into our own cloud, compute, and inference. Wherever you land, you will bring something rare: a deep, hands-on understanding of how AI and AI infrastructure actually behave for real customers.

We make the decision together based on your performance in the queue, how you handled sidequests, and whether the team you want to join has a role for you. So far, AI Associates have graduated into Account/AI Adoption Management, Sales and Solutions Engineering. We are looking to broaden the program as a gateway into all business functions.

You Might Be a Fit If… 

- You are fascinated by how AI works. You have gone down rabbit holes on why models behave the way they do, and you want a job where that curiosity is the core of the work.

- You want to understand the stack, not just the surface. Cloud software, APIs, and inference interest you, and you are excited to learn how models are served, scaled, and made fast and reliable.

- You are genuinely excited about front-line AI support. You take pride in helping customers, write with patience and clarity, and enjoy working through a busy ticket queue.

- You think in systems and love analysis. You enjoy breaking down tricky technical or operational problems and figuring out what is really happening under the hood.

- You show high agency and full ownership. You see a ticket through from first message to resolution and dig into root causes so the same issues do not keep coming back.

- You experiment constantly. You try new models, automations, and tools, and you instinctively look for ways technology can make work easier.

- You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus and useful in the queue.

- You are kind and care about the people around you. 

What We Need 

- Availability to start full-time and work 100% on-site at our Berlin office for the full 12 months.

- A work permit for Germany.

- Technical or analytical grounding. Studies or hands-on experience in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or a track record of building technical projects, is a plus but not a requirement. Curiosity about how AI and cloud systems work is.

The Environment 

You will work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution, and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense.

Compensation 

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next Steps 

We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks. If you want to spend a year truly understanding AI, from the conversation down to the compute, we would love to hear from you.

Compensation: €65K – €80K • Offers Equity

description:

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role 

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You'd own the design and delivery of Mews' first dedicated commercial enablement function inside Onboarding: turning onboarding professionals across a global, distributed team into consultants who can spot and act on expansion revenue, without inheriting anyone else's playbook.

Most onboarding organisations treat go-live as the finish line, so the upsell and cross-sell signals sitting inside existing project portfolios go unqualified and never reach Sales. At Mews, that gap sits inside a fast-growing hospitality tech customer base, where every project portfolio onboarding already manages is effectively an unworked pipeline of expansion revenue.

You'll work closely with Onboarding leadership globally, plus Sales, Customer Success and RevOps, to define what a qualified expansion lead looks like and get it moving to the right team. This is a new role, not a backfill, so the coaching model, playbooks and success metrics are yours to build from scratch.

This role exists because Onboarding's project portfolios are growing faster than the team's ability to work them commercially, and right now, nobody owns that motion end to end.

What you would do 

- Design and deliver consultative sales training for onboarding professionals, covering discovery, opportunity qualification, objection handling and commercial conversations that keep the customer's trust intact

- Build an ongoing coaching programme that grows consultative skill progressively, from new joiners through tenured consultants, and onboard new starters into the commercial side of the role from day one

- Develop playbooks and frameworks, including AI-assisted tools, that help the team surface and qualify upsell and cross-sell signals across their project portfolios at scale

- Partner with Sales, Customer Success and RevOps to define a qualified expansion lead and build the handoff process between Onboarding and Sales

- Track commercial performance across the portfolio (pipeline generated, expansion revenue influenced, handoff quality) and use it to keep improving the programme

AI Fluency Level 3: in this role, that means redesigning how the wider onboarding team spots and qualifies commercial signals, not just using AI to work faster yourself. You'll build AI-assisted frameworks and tools that other onboarding professionals can use on their own portfolios, and you'll actively check what those tools flag before it shapes a playbook or gets treated as a qualified lead.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates" . 

What you would bring 

- 4+ years in Revenue Enablement, Sales Enablement or Commercial Training, with direct exposure to consultative or solution-selling methodologies

- A background as a quota-carrying sales rep, account manager or customer success leader: you've had the commercial conversations you'll be teaching others to have

- Deep familiarity with consultative sales frameworks (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN or equivalent), and comfort adapting them to a post-sale, trust-based context

- A coaching instinct: you can watch a customer interaction, spot the missed commercial moment, and give feedback specific enough to change what happens next time

- AI Fluency Level 3 or equivalent hands-on experience: comfortable redesigning workflows with AI, building tools colleagues can reuse, and checking AI output rather than taking it at face value

Nice to have 

- A data-driven mindset: comfortable defining success metrics and iterating a programme based on results

- Experience designing and delivering training for customer-facing teams in a SaaS B2B environment

- Strong facilitation and presentation skills, and comfort operating across a large, distributed global team where influence often has to happen without formal authority

What’s in it for you? 

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits 

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

- Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)

- Participation in our company share program

- Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)

- An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development

- Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself

- A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year

- Relocation options, available after one year

- Flexible, hybrid working options

- A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance

- Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits 

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews 

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

- High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

At Wiz, we're passionate about technical sales and helping our partners and their customers achieve maximum value. title: Software Engineer I
description:
About Tripadvisor 

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences . We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About the Role 

We’re looking for a curious, high-potential Software Engineer I to join our Experiences Engineering team. This is a junior, full-stack role, working with Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools . It’s designed for engineers who have strong fundamentals and are hungry to grow in a fast-paced, product-driven environment. If you love the idea of shipping code to millions of travelers and want to learn how to build at scale, this is the place for you!

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1 hour) of one of our office hubs in London, Oxford, Krakow or Lisbon. 

What You’ll Do 

- Ship Frequently: You’ll be part of the full software lifecycle, from design and coding to testing and deployment. You’ll release code to production on an almost daily basis.

- Learn & Grow: Work cross-functionally alongside product, design, and data experts to understand why we build, not just how.

- Partner with AI: Leverage agentic coding tools for routine tasks like writing boilerplate, unit tests, and small refactors, using AI as a "force multiplier" to help you learn faster.

- Build Quality: Design and implement clean, readable solutions with a strong focus on automated unit and integration testing.

- Collaborate: Participate in design reviews, ask questions, and actively seek feedback to sharpen your technical and professional skills.

Skills & Experience 

We typically look for 0-2 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Sci.

- Technical Fundamentals : A strong grasp of computer science basics—data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming.

- Full-Stack Exposure: Familiarity with web app development, including proficiency in at least one modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and a basic understanding of relational databases like MySQL or PostgreSQL.

- AI Coding: you are comfortable coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code. 

- Growth Mindset : A genuine desire to learn new technologies and a "global-first" mindset for collaborating with teammates around the world.

- Clear Communication: The ability to explain your logic and talk through blockers with your team.

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively. 

We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our coding interview exercises in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!

What We Offer 

- Competitive compensation packages , including base salary, annual bonus, and more.

- “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations. 

- Flexible schedule . Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.

- Donation matching . Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.

- Tuition assistance . Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.

- Lifestyle benefit . An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.

- Travel perks . We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.

- Employee assistance program . We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.

- Health benefits . We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.

- Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars: 

- Traveller first: We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

- Execution is our edge: We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 

- We succeed together: The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Discover more in our Tech Blog , for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group. 

Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our ED&I strategy shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands.

title: AI Modelling and Simulation Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

Lumai is moving from breakthrough optical-compute research to production AI systems. We need an engineer to build the performance and power modelling capability that guides architecture and compiler decisions before silicon exists, helping us turn a working system into a competitive product.

The Role

You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai’s photonic AI hardware will perform against real inference workloads. Your models will give architecture and compiler teams a shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across hardware configurations.

The hard part is balancing speed, fidelity and usability: you will model concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency at enough detail to support decisions, while keeping simulations fast enough to compare configurations in minutes. You will characterise operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results so the model stays grounded in evidence.

By month six, you will have established a reliable modelling flow for priority workloads and device configurations, demonstrated a clear path for closing gaps between model and hardware, and made the simulator a tool that architecture and compiler teams use to make decisions. You will report to the Head of Architecture or VP Engineering and may build and lead a small team around this capability.

What You'll Do

- Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships.

- Model compute engines, interconnect and synchronisation fabric, memory and bridge interfaces, and accelerator blocks across device configurations.

- Characterise convolution, depthwise convolution, pooling, attention and other operator workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results.

- Build compiler-agnostic interfaces that ingest compiled models and MLIR from multiple internal compiler flows.

- Analyse simulation traces with architecture and compiler teams to improve layer-to-hardware mappings and resolve performance discrepancies.

- Run industry benchmarks and representative models, including UL Procyon, Geekbench AI, Stable Diffusion and contemporary LLMs, to produce decision-ready KPIs.

- Develop block-level power models and validate worst-case power scenarios with micro-architecture, verification and physical-design teams.

- Own the CI/CD pipelines and simulation flows that keep results reliable and reproducible as usage scales.

- Translate modelling findings into architecture and compiler decisions, while setting technical direction and developing engineers or interns as the team grows.

What We're Looking For

Must-have 

- Proven experience building or substantially extending a hardware/software performance-modelling or simulation framework for AI/ML accelerators, ideally in Python.

- Strong understanding of hardware concurrency, event-driven modelling, and AI inference accelerator micro-architecture, including compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect and dataflow.

- Hands-on experience characterising AI operators and correlating model predictions with real hardware or hardware-accurate reference data.

- Familiarity with compiler internals and intermediate representations such as MLIR, including tooling that consumes compiler output to drive simulation.

- Strong software-engineering and technical-leadership practice, including framework design, CI/CD ownership and direction or review of work by junior engineers or interns.

Strong preference for 

- Direct experience with NPU, GPU or other edge or client AI inference accelerator architectures.

- Experience working across multiple compiler toolchains and reconciling architecture-level and production compiler behaviour.

- Exposure to power modelling, RTL, emulation, FPGA prototyping, photonic compute or another non-traditional compute architecture.

About Lumai 

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched Iris Nova, the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time, using up to 90% less energy than conventional GPU-based systems. Iris Nova, the first server in the family, is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Aura and Tetra will follow.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai 

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

Equal Opportunity 

Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you.

- Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

- Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders

- Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity

- Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans

The Head of Operations owns the system that runs Rainham: the plan, the standard, the data and the forward view. This is a new role, created as Rainham becomes both a refurb centre and a national distribution site from January 2027.

This is a planning, analytical and continuous improvement role first as well as a people management role. The Head of Operations will build the system the warehouse team, mechanic team and distribution team deliver against and will be ultimately accountable for whether the site performs both efficiently and effectively.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities 

1. Demand, capacity and forward planning 

- Own capacity planning end to end: built stock cover, inbound space, returns and disposal flow, physical site capacity as the site takes on distribution volume.

- Build and stress test the peak plan well ahead of demand, including Christmas peak, modelling labour, space and carrier capacity against it.

- Run rigorous what-if scenario planning: model the impact of demand shifts, supply delays, absence and carrier disruption before they happen, not after.

- Set build volume targets from demand and the labour model that delivers them, and own whether the number lands.

2. Data, systems and reporting 

- Own data integrity across the site: build, dispatch and inventory reporting must reconcile, and any variance is investigated, not repeated.

- Fluent in Salesforce (ideal) and confident evaluating or evolving a WMS suited to the site's needs as it scales.

- Own the design of scanning, location and inventory status processes/workflow that the Distribution Manager and Mechanic Team execute.

- Build the reporting the business needs to trust: no repeat of build numbers running on an unvalidated figure

3. Inventory and stock governance 

- Own inventory accuracy, cycle count governance and disposal authorisation across the site

- Set the reorder points and supplier process for packaging and consumables for the Distribution Manager to own and execute upon.

- Reconcile stock movements regularly and investigate variance as standard daily practice - not as a reaction to a discovered problem.

4. Performance framework and quality 

- Design and own the performance framework: what good output looks like, how it is measured, and when it is escalated

- Design the QC gates built into both the build and despatch process, so defects are caught by design and automation where applicable.

- Set the standard for order completeness and despatch accuracy, and firmly hold the site to it.

- Own the formal performance management framework, including how underperformance is identified, documented and addressed

5. Continuous improvement 

- Continuous improvement is a default operating habit of this role, not a project or an initiative

- Bring a lean methodology to daily operations: identify waste, standardise process, remove friction, on an ongoing basis

- Apply automation and AI where it genuinely improves accuracy or throughput 6. Despatch performance

- Single point of accountability for on-time-in-full dispatch performance to all members. The Distribution Manager owns the execution but you are accountable.

7. Team leadership 

- Lead all Site functions; the Distribution Manager, the warehouse (Goods In/Bike Wash teams), and the Mechanic Teams.

- Set clear objectives for each line, reviewed monthly, and hold each accountable for delivery against the plan

- Build the structure needed under each line as the site scales, including supervisory layers where a team requires one. (i.e. Mechanic supervisor)

- Maintain and continuously improve the company’s safety management systems in alignment with OHSAS

Performance Metrics 

- OTIF despatch performance, site wide

- Inventory accuracy and cycle count variance

- 100% fulfilment guarantee. (if a SKU is available and not on site it must be built within 24hrs)

- Build output against target, and build quality against standard

- Packaging and consumables stock cover, zero stockouts.

- Data reconciliation accuracy, build to despatch to inventory

- Peak plan delivery against forecast

- Continuous improvement initiatives delivered and their measured impact

Requirements

Skills and Experience 

Essential 

- Proven experience running a modern, multi-function warehouse or distribution site at scale

- Background in D2C logistics and industrial manufacturing

- Strong quantitative and analytical ability: comfortable building and interrogating models, not just reading dashboards

- Genuine continuous improvement or lean background, applied as a default way of working to black belt standard.

- AI native - Fluency and experience is a must

- Commercially and technically fluent, including confidence with Salesforce, WMS systems and warehouse automation

- Track record of building control environments: inventory accuracy, reporting integrity, performance frameworks, where none existed before

- Experience managing carrier relationships

- Strong people leadership through both line managers and direct floor management Desirable

- Experience in a circular economy or refurbishment-led operating model

- Experience building a WMS from scratch or its continuous evolution

- Peak season planning experience in a high SKU count, seasonal demand environment

Our Values 

We look for people who live our values every day: 

Ease: we make things simple for our members and for each other. 

Care: we look after our customers, our colleagues and our bikes. 

Progress: we keep improving, learning and raising the bar. 

Joy: we help kids fall in love with cycling, and enjoy the work we do. 

Benefits

🌴We offer 26 days per year + bank holidays

💷Pension salary sacrifice

🏡Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave

🚴Employee Discount on our bikes and Cycle to Work Scheme

Why Bike Club? 

You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow.

This is a rare opportunity to build the operating system for our national refurbishment and distribution site from the ground up, shaping how Bike Club gets the right bike to every family, right when they need it.

title: Senior Payments Manager
description:
Why loveholidays? 
At loveholidays - we trailblaze together . We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Commercial and Support teams , you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams.

About the team: 

The Payments function has been recognised as a strategic area for the business, with the capacity to significantly impact key metrics: conversion rates, cost reduction, compliance, customer satisfaction and retention.

The Senior Payments Manager at loveholidays will report into the Head of Payments and will have the opportunity to influence the future structure of the team as it continues growing.

Given the cross-functional nature of payments, you will work very closely with the dedicated Product and Engineering functions responsible for Payments, as well as a multitude of internal and external stakeholders.

The impact you’ll have: 

The role will be primarily responsible for establishing new and managing existing commercial relationships with our payment providers, agreeing new contracts, improving terms and conditions and ensuring they are able to offer us the products, features and services we need so we continue to meet customer needs across markets and across the different payments touch points:

- New, as part of the checkout journey

- Scheduled, between having booked and travel, when customers have opted for a payment plan

- Customer, when customers make ad-hoc payments through our app or the Manage My Booking portal.

The Senior Payments Manager is an expert in the Payments Industry with in-depth knowledge of the different aspects of this industry: commercial, product, technical, regulatory, and will support - and deputise for - the Head of Payments in guiding the company through key decisions as we expand internationally.

In addition, this role is also responsible for maximising the incentive generated by payments on VCCs when paying direct suppliers.

Your day-to-day: 

- Manage day to day relationships with our payment partners, and be a key liaison between internal and external.

- Manage the process to sign new or amend existing agreements

- Negotiate pricing

- Run weekly calls, QBRs, identify and track areas of opportunity

- As Admin of these accounts, support internal controls to minimise risks.

- Working closely with key internal stakeholders, combined with your in-depth knowledge of the industry and experience in previous similar roles, provide recommendations in terms of how to further optimise our customer payment operations, whilst ensuring alignment with the organisation's overall objectives.

- Build robust relationships with business owners in Managing, Selling, and Scaling operations. The Senior Product Manager - Payments will be a key ally.

- Keep the company informed of compliance with local and international regulatory requirements.

- Support the Head of with the forecast, budget and actual monitoring of payment processing fees, which is the largest component of the Variable Costs line in our P&L.

- Stay up to date with industry trends and innovation, bringing this knowledge in-house and raising internal awareness of changes in this area.

- Stay up to date with competitor offerings in terms of payments, steering the company through ways to differentiate ourselves.

- Leverage relationships with external technical suppliers, vendors and partners to align them with our own goals and get the most out of our agreements

- Manage and improve the operational efficiency of our VCC supplier payments, maximising acceptance and incentives.

- Teach the company about the payments industry, key trends, evolution, and the impact it could generate in the business if done right, or wrong!

Your skillset: 

- Track record in managing Payments commercial relationships, negotiating and improving terms.

- Knowledgeable in the payments ecosystem, main stakeholders and drivers, not only for card payments but also for alternative forms of payments, ideally across Europe.

- Outstanding commercial insight and be able to identify and realise business opportunities.

- Extensive network and ability to find the answers for any unknown elements.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC - (EMEA Only) 

An overview of this role 

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists 

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do 

Product contribution 

- Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.

- Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.

- Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.

- Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.

- Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship 

- Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.

- Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.

- Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.

- Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.

- Balance performance, usability, reliability, manufacturability, regulatory requirements and cost across the product lifecycle.

- Master's degree with 4+ years of industry experience in mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering or a related discipline.

- A track record of taking medical devices or consumer wearables from concept through to volume manufacture.

- Experience leading the mechanical design of highly miniaturised or densely integrated products.

- Expert CAD and drafting skills, including complex assemblies and surfacing, with a strong command of engineering drawings, GD&T and manufacturing tolerances.

- Extensive experience designing injection moulded plastic components for volume manufacture, including overmoulding, multi-shot or insert moulding.

- Experience leading tolerance stack analysis and applying statistical tolerancing to critical assemblies.

- Experience designing sealed, leak-tight or ingress-protected assemblies and developing associated test methods.

- Strong knowledge of assembly methods including snap fits, heat staking, ultrasonic and laser welding, adhesives and overmoulding.

- Experience leading DFMEA, contributing to PFMEA and applying structured risk management in line with ISO 14971.

- Experience working within an ISO 13485 or equivalent quality system, including design controls, change control, product release and PLM systems.

- Experience defining and executing V&V plans and mechanical test methods.

- Experience managing external suppliers, tooling vendors and contract manufacturers, including tooling trials and production transfer.

- Proven ability to lead structured root cause analysis on complex mechanical failures.

- Experience designing products with user needs at the centre of development.

- Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design reviews.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to influence across multidisciplinary engineering teams and with senior stakeholders.

Nice to have: 

- Experience designing skin-adhered or continuously worn medical devices (e.g. CGMs, patch pumps, cardiac monitors)

- Experience designing pumps, valves, diaphragms, microfluidics or other fluid-handling mechanisms

- Experience with IEC 60601, ISO 10993 biocompatibility or IEC 62366 usability engineering

- Experience designing precision mechanical mechanisms, such as applicators or insertion mechanisms

- Experience with sterilisation-compatible design and material selection

- Familiarity with Design of Experiments (DOE) and statistical data analysis

- Experience with FEA for structural, thermal or fatigue assessment

- Experience with rapid prototyping, machining and 3D printing

- Prior work in a start-up or small company environment

- Experience building or scaling an engineering team

- You live and breathe integrity, tackling challenges with honesty and transparency.

- You're a self-starter who loves diving into the unknown, collaborating on complex problems, and taking full ownership of results.

- You excel at open, clear communication and see every piece of feedback as a springboard for growth—especially in a science and data-focused environment.

- You're motivated by creating real impact, particularly when it comes to advancing human health.

- You strike a balance between independence and collaboration, knowing when to seek support or invite others to join in.

- You're confident in defending your ideas, while also valuing respectful, constructive debate as a path to better solutions.

- You thrive in the dynamic atmosphere of a startup, constantly evolving your skill set and fearlessly applying what you learn

What we offer

- The chance to grow with us, including ample opportunities for leadership, career advancement, and exploration.

- Travel to New York and other potential sites for R&D purposes.

- The excitement of working on cutting-edge technology, shaping strategic decisions, and driving innovation at an early-stage venture alongside a superstar team.

Be Part of Our Journey

title: Professional Services Engineer - Cloudflare Implementation

Your responsibility is the build, validation and client-facing technical implementation .

The client portfolio includes French banks, industrial groups, public bodies and media organisations. You will regularly work directly with their technical teams in French, explaining what you are implementing, why particular decisions have been made and how production changes will be managed.

This is not a back-office engineering role .

We are hiring at two levels:

- Senior Engineer: capable of owning a Cloudflare migration end to end and independently leading technical conversations with clients. 
- Mid-Level Engineer: strong network/security fundamentals and implementation experience, with the opportunity to deepen Cloudflare expertise through structured training and certification. 
What You Will Do

Cloudflare Implementation & Migration

- Configure and deploy Cloudflare environments across DNS, CDN and caching, WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, load balancing, Bot Management, Zero Trust and Access, tunnels and SASE components . 
- Deliver migrations from incumbent platforms, particularly Akamai and other CDN/WAF providers . 
- Handle rule translation, traffic cutover planning, staged deployment and rollback design. 
- Plan and execute production DNS cutovers , ensuring a validated rollback is available at every stage. 
- Build and deliver pilots and proofs of concept, from individual applications through to full production rollouts. 
- Test, validate and tune deployed environments, including cache-hit ratio, latency, WAF false positives and other client-relevant performance characteristics. 
Client-Facing Technical Delivery

- Lead technical working sessions with client teams in French, including workshops, configuration reviews, cutover rehearsals and go-live calls. 
- Explain technical decisions, risks and implementation considerations clearly to both engineers and management stakeholders. 
- Produce client-facing technical documentation in French and English , including configuration records, runbooks, cutover plans and project-closure documentation. 
- Identify and raise technical or delivery risks as soon as they become visible rather than allowing them to surface late in the project. 
Working Within the Delivery Model

- Provide clear and accurate progress updates and flag potential delays or blockers early. 
- Escalate architecture and design questions to the Principal Architect rather than making unapproved architectural changes during delivery. 
- Maintain accurate project timesheets and record effort against the appropriate projects. 
- Identify and communicate potential out-of-scope client requests to the Delivery Manager. 
- Deliver a structured handover into managed services at project closure, including complete documentation, runbooks and known risks, allowing the support team to operate the environment effectively from day one. 
Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

- Work with implementation engineers in Dubai and Poland, managed services teams in Morocco and the Philippines, and pre-sales and architecture teams in France. 
- Use Zoho Projects and BrixioOne as the source of truth for project tasks, documentation and reporting. 
- Contribute to BRIXIO's internal knowledge base and reusable implementation patterns and playbooks. 
- Support managed services teams with escalations requiring deeper implementation expertise. 
- Share technical knowledge across the wider delivery organisation. 

Requirements 

What We're Looking For

Technical Foundation

You should have a strong practical understanding of:

- DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS and certificates 
- Proxies and reverse proxies 
- Caching and CDN mechanics 
- Web application architecture 
- Origin infrastructure 
- Cloud fundamentals across AWS, Azure or GCP 
You should be able to clearly explain what happens between a browser and an origin infrastructure and confidently troubleshoot problems across that path.

You will also need a solid grounding in web application security, including:

- WAF concepts 
- OWASP Top 10 
- Bot mitigation 
- DDoS attack patterns 
- Rate limiting 
You should be comfortable using technical troubleshooting tools including:

- curl 
- dig 
- traceroute 
- Browser developer tools 
- Packet capture tools where required 
You should also have scripting and automation capability using technologies such as Python, Bash or Terraform , together with experience working with REST APIs .

Experience with Cloudflare Workers is a strong advantage.

Cloudflare Experience

For the Senior position , hands-on Cloudflare implementation experience is required.

For the Mid-Level position , Cloudflare experience is a strong advantage but is not mandatory where you bring strong experience with comparable CDN, WAF or Zero Trust technologies .

Candidates coming from platforms such as Akamai or other relevant CDN/security technologies can be considered where the underlying technical foundation is strong.

BRIXIO provides access to Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification to support continued development.

Delivery Experience

Senior Engineer

- 5+ years of experience implementing network, security or cloud infrastructure for external clients. 
- Demonstrated experience owning technical delivery within client-facing projects. 
- Hands-on Cloudflare implementation experience. 
- Ability to independently lead technical client discussions and implementation activities. 
Mid-Level Engineer

- 3+ years of relevant experience in network, security or cloud environments. 
- Alternatively, strong technical support or NOC experience combined with genuine implementation exposure. 
- Strong technical fundamentals and the ability to develop deeper Cloudflare expertise. 
For Both Levels

- Experience working within a professional services, consultancy, MSP or systems integrator environment with committed project timelines. 
- Experience with production cutovers or migrations under formal change control is a significant advantage. 
- Confidence working directly with external clients. 
Languages

French is the primary working language for this portfolio. You will conduct technical workshops, participate in cutover and go-live calls, and prepare client-facing technical documentation in French.

English is required for collaboration with BRIXIO's international teams and work involving Gulf and Asian accounts.

Both French and English will be assessed during the interview process. 

Working Pattern

The role operates primarily during Central European working hours .

Some client migrations and production go-lives will require planned out-of-hours presence. These windows will be agreed in advance and compensated.

The position is remote from Morocco, with collaboration through the Equans IT Hub in Casablanca and occasional travel to client sites in France and elsewhere in Europe.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is:

- Rigorous and methodical when working with production environments. 
- Disciplined about documenting configurations and changes as work progresses. 
- Comfortable working directly with clients, including when communicating technical risks or problems.

Why BRIXIO?

title: Data Scientist (Contract)
description:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

- 100M+ conversations per month

- 150+ brand clients

- a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

We are accelerating. The product works, clients renew, the market is taking shape. Every day, shoppers talk to AI agents before they buy, and conversion has been at the heart of how we build the product from day one. We now want to go further and faster, with someone fully dedicated to understanding what turns a conversation into a purchase, and to proving it with data.

As our freelance Data Scientist, full-time, you will dig into everything we have and tell us what drives conversion, what to change in the product next, and how to prove it. You will build on the work already done, challenge it, and find the levers we have not seen yet. You will work directly with the founders and the product and engineering teams.

Understand what drives conversion

- Explore every data source we have: natural-language conversations, behavioural events, conversion tracking, product and advertiser metadata

- Turn raw conversations into usable signals (intents, categories, features) that you define and build

- Link what our agents say (answers, recommendations, tone) to what users do next, and turn it into concrete improvements for the agent team

- Find the next levers that move purchases, and size the impact of each one

Experiment

- Turn your findings into prioritised hypotheses the product team can act on

- Design the A/B tests that validate them, then read the results

- The engineering team implements the variants: you do not write production code

Strengthen what we measure

- Spot the remaining blind spots in what we measure and specify the events and properties we are missing, for the engineering team to implement

Profile

Must-have

- 4+ years of hands-on data science or analytics, with analyses that changed a product or business decision.

- Advanced SQL and Python for data

- Strong statistics and experimentation: A/B test design, causal reasoning, and the judgment to separate real effects from noise, selection bias and measurement artifacts, and to know when the data is too thin to conclude

- Autonomous: you find the right questions in an open problem

- AI-forward: you use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, agents) daily

- Fluent French and professional English

- Available now, full-time

A plus

- NLP on real text data: classification, clustering, LLM-based labelling

- E-commerce or retail experience

- Conversion, CRO or funnel analytics

- BigQuery, PostHog

- Adtech or performance-marketing measurement (attribution, ROAS)

- Familiarity with ranking, recommendations or search relevance

- Startup experience

No school requirement.

The mission

- Freelance, full-time, starting ASAP

- 1 month minimum, around 3 months expected

- For the right person, the mission can turn into a permanent role

- Our data stack: BigQuery, PostHog, Python

Why join us

- Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

- Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

- Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic interfaces

- Own mission-critical topics, grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory

🏨 The company

Resilience Care is a leading medical remote monitoring player and a clinical research partner. Founded in France in 2021, our mission is simple: improve patient care.
We build remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, powered by ePRO collection and AI techniques. Our platform helps care teams detect side effects early for continuous and proactive care, while our patient app helps people track and manage symptoms with tailored resources.
Our solutions optimize care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and detailed analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies.
We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your role

In a nutshell : You join the Data Reliability Engineering (DRE) team to build, operate and secure the data platform that carries healthcare data from our production services to the people who use it — internal operational teams, clinical research users, and external partners receiving contractual data exports.

Your impact : Data arrives on time, complete, traceable and secure — and when it doesn't, we know before the users do. You turn one-off data requests and manual export procedures into automated, monitored, reproducible pipelines.

Your day-to-day :

- Build and operate data pipelines : ingestion from application events & databases, transformation, export.

- Build the tooling that handles those pipelines, hand in hand with SRE : infrastructure as code ( Terraform , Helm on Kubernetes), deployment, CI/CD, secrets management, database operations and incident response.

title: Senior Workforce Manager - Capacity Planning & BPO Strategy
description:

Join us as Senior Workforce Manager – Capacity Planning & BPO Strategy to own the global capacity planning framework across all of Qonto's Ops factories — Banking Operations, AML/Fraud, KYCB, and Customer Care & Success. You'll set the methodology every factory uses, hold the consolidated budget view, and be the senior owner of BPO relationships at a strategic and contractual level. This is a hands-on build-and-run role: you'll design the model and direct its rollout, under the guidance of Marie Piquemil , our Head of Operations Enablement.

➡️ What you'll do

- Design and own the capacity planning framework: You'll build the reference model — volume drivers, FTE requirements, BPO productive-hours — and set the forecasting cadence, templates, and definitions every factory's WFM analyst works from.

- Optimise the internal vs. BPO capacity mix: You'll build the system that determines the right balance of internal agents and BPO capacity to cover workload at the lowest sustainable cost and risk, across all factories.

- Own the global BPO budget view: You'll hold the actuals-vs-plan picture for exec reporting, interface with Finance on planning and reconciliation, and surface cross-factory cost inefficiencies invisible at the local level.

- Lead BPO relationships at a strategic level: You'll be the senior point of contact for BPO partners on capacity, contracts, and escalations — and define the invoice validation standard used across all factories.

- Enable and align factory-level WFM analysts: You'll set the standards and operating cadence for factory analysts through dotted-line governance, and run the monthly cross-factory alignment ritual covering forecast review, capacity risk, and invoice anomalies.

➡️ What we're looking for

- WFM leadership with BPO depth: You've got 5+ years in Workforce Management, with hands-on exposure to both BPO-managed and internal-agent capacity models.

- Methodology builder, not just operator: You've designed or significantly overhauled a capacity planning framework — you know what it takes to build one from scratch, not just run what's already there.

- BPO vendor ownership: You've managed outsourcing relationships at a contractual and strategic level — SLAs, invoicing, escalations — and held partners accountable to real standards.

- Influence-based leader: You're effective without direct authority — you set standards, coach local relays, and drive adoption across semi-autonomous teams who don't report to you.

- AI-curious: You look for ways to use AI to work faster and smarter, and you're ready to keep adapting as the role evolves with it.

- French and English fluency: You have a strong command of both French and English. 

➡️ What we can offer you

- A founding mandate in a brand-new, centralized operations function — you'll help shape how it works from day one.

- Direct line of sight into Qonto's banking license transition , raising the bar on operational rigor as the company scales.

- Real autonomy over a strategic mission with executive visibility into the outcome.

- A seat at the table as a genuine business partner to Finance and factory leadership, not just an operator.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Marie Piquemil , our Head of Operations Enablement.

- Her path? Marie spent five years as COO at Morning, then built and led an international CX operations team at Swile (7 people across France and Brazil, five post-merger integrations). Most recently as VP Operations at Combo, she ran RevOps, Enablement, and Data teams, drove a post-merger integration, and launched a new Payroll Business Unit from scratch. She's been an operator, a builder, and a manager of managers.

- What does she bring to the team? Marie has built exactly the kind of cross-functional operations infrastructure this role will strengthen. She'll give you the strategic context and the autonomy to own your projects — while staying close on the decisions that matter.

title: Signal Processing Engineer (Radar)
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities.

Responsibilities 

- Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets.

- Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data.

- Build jamming estimation capabilities, combining out-of-band spectral sniffing with in-band spatial covariance analysis, and the adaptive logic that drives radar behavior in response.

- Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable.

- Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints.

- Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results.

- Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements.

Candidate Requirements

- 2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably.

- Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus.

- Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions.

- A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight.

- Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
description:
Your mission The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.

The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.

In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 

The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.

Tasks and Responsabilities - Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
- Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
- Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
- Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
- Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
- Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
- Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
- Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
- Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
- Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
- Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
- Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
- Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
- Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
- Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.

Your Profile - An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
- Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
- Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
- Passion and commitment to student support and success.
- Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
- Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
- Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
- Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies 
- Communication Connection and Service 
- Global Mindset 
- Achieving Results 
- Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
- Learning and Development 
- Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
- Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement 
- Leadership skills 
- Strong intercultural communication skills and cultural agility

title: Agentic Compiler Engineer
description:
ABOUT KOG

Kog builds a co-designed inference stack for real-time AI agents on standard datacenter GPUs, spanning model architecture, inference engine, compilers, and low-level GPU kernels.

On the model side, we developed Laneformer 2B and Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP), a Transformer architecture that overlaps communication with useful computation and weight streaming.

On the systems side, the Kog Inference Engine runs this stack on standard AMD and NVIDIA datacenter GPUs.

Kog generates 3,500 tokens/s per request on 8 AMD MI300X GPUs and 2,100 tokens/s per request on 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, in FP16 at batch size 1, with quantization and speculative decoding disabled.

Our next major project is AGCO, our agentic compiler. AGCO is designed to optimize LLMs across different GPUs and optimization targets, including very fast inference.

The team has 10 people, including 9 engineers and researchers and 4 PhDs.

Test it at playground.kog.ai. Read the technical details on the Kog Labs blog.

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

You will work directly on AGCO.

The goal is to build a system that can explore ways to optimize LLM execution, generate changes, compile them, check correctness, run them on real hardware, measure the results, and use this feedback to guide the next optimization.

You will contribute to areas such as:

- Compiler and IR design for representing and transforming LLM computations.

- Optimization passes, lowering, and code generation.

- Search methods for exploring different implementations and execution strategies.

- Verification and correctness checks for generated changes.

- GPU execution, profiling, and performance optimization.

- LLM inference across operators, memory, parallelism, and communication.

- Optimization loops that connect generated changes to measurements on real GPUs.

One direction we are exploring combines an IR, a verifier, a compiler, and a search optimizer. We plan to start with focused problems, build working prototypes, and extend the system from what we learn.

Your main area will depend on your experience, skills, and interests. You may focus more on compilers, GPU systems, or LLM inference while working closely with people across the full stack.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We look for engineers with deep technical expertise and original work in at least one area relevant to AGCO.

Relevant experience includes:

- Compiler engineering, including optimization passes, IRs, lowering, code generation, LLVM, or MLIR.

- GPU programming with CUDA, HIP, Metal, Vulkan, or similar technologies.

- GPU performance work involving kernels, memory, synchronization, profiling, or hardware behavior.

- LLM inference engines and performance optimization.

- Attention, MoE, parallelism, communication, or other systems-level parts of LLM execution.

- Formal verification, equivalence checking, SAT/SMT, or related methods.

- Systems that generate, search, test, benchmark, or optimize code automatically.

We care about what you personally built and the technical decisions behind it. Strong candidates can explain the problem, their approach, the alternatives they explored, and how they measured the result.

We review technical work during the process. This can be public code, an upstream contribution, a paper, a thesis, a technical project, or a detailed write-up based on work you can share.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will join a small team building AGCO as a core part of Kog's technology.

- Work at the intersection of compilers, GPU systems, and LLM inference.

- Direct access to engineers working across the full inference stack.

- A fast loop from an optimization idea to compilation, execution, verification, and measurement on real GPUs.

- The opportunity to go deep in your strongest technical area while expanding into the other parts of the stack.

- High ownership over technical decisions and systems that will shape how Kog optimizes LLM inference.

This role is based in Paris, and we are looking for candidates who can relocate to Paris and work closely with the team.

This is a focused, partially technical role that requires depth over breadth: you go deep into the specifications of eID schemes and EUDI Wallets rather than staying at a surface level. 

Key Responsibilities

- Identity Interoperability: Ensure seamless cross-border identity verification, managing the nuances of different EU member state requirements, national eID schemes, and trust frameworks. 

- Conversion Optimization: Analyze the friction-versus-security trade-off for each identification method and provide clear recommendations to help customers maximize their onboarding rates. 

- Own the end-to-end specification of eID and EUDI Wallet integrations, going into technical detail on protocols, data models, and trust frameworks. 

- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Solutions teams to translate regulatory requirements into concrete product and technical specifications.

- Show a high level of autonomy and ownership: this is a focused scope that requires a strong, detail-oriented executor who can work independently while always keeping track of business metrics and customer feedback. 

- Communicate complex regulatory and technical topics clearly to engineering teams, senior stakeholders, customers, and internal enablement audiences.
