- Create net-new pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner motion, events, and customer referrals.

- Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and forecasting, and report proactively on progress, risks, and what you need from the organization.

Insight-led selling and deal shaping 

- Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing and introduce a sharper point of view on where value is trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls).

- Run executive discovery to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate it into a crisp target-state narrative, urgency, and mutual action plan.

- Build internal alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees, including champions, economic buyers, IT/security, and process owners.

Commercial ownership: value case, negotiation, and close 

- Own the business case, pricing strategy, proposals, negotiation, and contracting.

- Quantify and communicate value (capacity release, cycle time reduction, control/compliance improvements, stack simplification) and tie it to executive priorities and budget.

- Drive the deal to closure with clear next steps, strong deal governance, and accurate forecasting.

Orchestration across presales and delivery 

- Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout).

- Align with Customer Success on implementation readiness, success criteria, and expansion paths.

- Ensure clean handoffs from close to kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes.

Competitive positioning 

- Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

- Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof.

What we're looking for

Must-haves 

- 5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets.

- Proven ability to run insight-led enterprise sales cycles: you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and mobilize buying committees.

- Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement.

- Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals: mutual action plans, MEDDICC-style qualification, forecasting discipline.

- Strong collaboration with presales/SE and post-sales teams; you sell what can be delivered.

Strong plus 

- ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations.

- Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents.

- Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders.

Language 

- Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory).

What you'll get

- A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

- Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

- Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

- Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

- Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

- Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

title: Software Architect (x)
description:
Über Greenflash Wir arbeiten für etwas, das größer ist als wir selbst. 
Wir gestalten die Energieversorgung der Industrie von morgen. Das erfordert Menschen mit Ambitionen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und einen spürbaren Beitrag leisten wollen. 

Wir vertrauen Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen. 
Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Initiative und Ergebnisse. Deshalb geben wir Menschen früh Verantwortung und den Freiraum, Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben. 

Wir wachsen gemeinsam. 
Große Ziele entstehen nicht durch Routine. Sie entstehen durch Lernen, Feedback und den Mut, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen. Genau dafür schaffen wir das passende Umfeld. 

Deine Mission - Softwarearchitektur gestalten: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die technische Architektur unserer Software und triffst gemeinsam mit dem Team fundierte Architekturentscheidungen.
- Technische Beratung: Du berätst Entwicklungsteams und Fachbereiche bei technischen Fragestellungen, bewertest unterschiedliche Ansätze und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
- Energie & Software verbinden: Du bringst dein Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung und Energiewirtschaft zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige technische Konzepte.
- Architektur in die Umsetzung bringen: Du begleitest die Entwicklung von der technischen Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass Architekturentscheidungen auch im Produkt ankommen.
- Sparring & Standards: Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für unsere Entwickler, schaffst Orientierung bei komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team technische Standards weiter.
- Verantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Teilbereich unserer EVU-Entwicklung und bringst deine Erfahrung ein, um unsere Software und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
- Mit aufbauen: Du hast Gestaltungsspielraum und wirkst am Aufbau unseres Bereichs für Energieversorger aktiv mit.

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft - Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und idealerweise bereits Erfahrung als Software Architect, Technical Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit.
- Energiewirtschaft: Du kennst die Energiewirtschaft und verstehst die fachlichen Zusammenhänge rund um Energieversorger.
- Architekturverständnis: Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge erfassen, Architekturentscheidungen fundiert treffen und diese verständlich vermitteln.
- Beratungsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne als technischer Sparringspartner, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen.
- Innovations- & Optimierungsdrang: Du hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und bringst neue Ideen in die Umsetzung.
- Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, triffst Entscheidungen und bewegst dich sicher in einem Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum.
- Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Produktverantwortung sowie Python, Airflow, Pandas, Energieflussprognosen oder Energieeinkauf und Intraday-Trading.

Warum Greenflash - Arbeite an etwas, das zählt. 
Die Energiewende gehört zu den größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bei Greenflash arbeitest du nicht an irgendeinem Projekt, sondern an Lösungen, die Unternehmen nachhaltiger, unabhängiger und zukunftsfähiger machen. Dein Beitrag wird sichtbar: in Projekten, bei Kunden und in den Ergebnissen, die wir gemeinsam erreichen.
- Mehr Verantwortung. Früher. 
Wer Initiative zeigt und etwas bewegen möchte, bekommt die Chance dazu. Entscheidungen treffen die Menschen, die nah am Thema sind. So entstehen Geschwindigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. 
- Wachstum durch Herausforderungen. 
Persönliche Entwicklung beginnt dort, wo die Komfortzone endet. Deshalb setzen wir auf spannende Aufgaben, ehrliches Feedback und Verantwortung statt auf standardisierte Karriereprogramme. Ergänzt wird das durch unsere Greenflash Academy und den täglichen Austausch mit Menschen, die ihr Wissen gerne teilen.
- Leistung, die sichtbar wird 
Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Ergebnisse und der Beitrag zum gemeinsamen Erfolg. Gute Leistung schafft Vertrauen. Vertrauen schafft Verantwortung. Und Verantwortung schafft Entwicklung. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen über sich hinauswachsen können und stolz auf das sind, was sie erreichen. 
- Ein Team mit Ambition 
Wir arbeiten an großen Zielen und glauben daran, dass außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse durch außergewöhnliche Teams entstehen. Deshalb setzen wir auf Offenheit, direkte Zusammenarbeit und Menschen, die füreinander einstehen. Ohne Politik. Ohne Silodenken. Dafür mit viel Vertrauen, Respekt und dem gemeinsamen Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden.
- Teil einer außergewöhnlichen Reise 
Greenflash ist nicht einfach ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit dem Anspruch, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten. Wer heute bei Greenflash startet, wird Teil einer Entwicklung, die gerade erst begonnen hat.
- Erfolge gemeinsam erleben 
Wir arbeiten mit hohen Ansprüchen. An unsere Arbeit. An unsere Ergebnisse. An uns selbst. Genauso wichtig ist, dass wir Erfolge gemeinsam feiern. Ob bei Team-Events, auf dem Padel-Court oder im Alltag – wir glauben daran, dass starke Leistung und starke Teams zusammengehören.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY 

freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”.

In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”.

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz.

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”.

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.

ÜBER DEINEN JOB 

Wir sind eine Engineering Organisation – auf jeder Ebene sind bei uns Engineers verantwortlich – auch in der Sicherheit. Deshalb kann nur ein echter Engineer unsere Security verantworten. Als Senior Security Engineer bist Du Primus inter Pares: Du beherrschst das Handwerk exzellent und steuerst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team die Compliance bei freiheit.com über Code und Automation.

Deine Rolle & Perspektive: 

- 
Führung mit Ziel: Du steigst an der Seite der aktuellen Leitung ein, lernst unsere Systeme tiefgreifend kennen und übernimmst mittelfristig die vollständige Führung des Security-Teams (direkt unter dem CEO).

- 
Strategischer Weitblick: Du planst technologische und regulatorische Anforderungen für die nächsten 6 bis 24 Monate proaktiv voraus.

- 
Engineering & Automation: Du entwickelst Infrastruktur selbst und automatisierst manuelle Aufwände konsequent durch Code.

- 
Compliance & Governance: Du trägst die Hauptverantwortung für unser ISMS (TISAX), steuerst das Incident Handling und prüfst Verträge rund um IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz (unterstützt von Fachanwälten & HiSolutions).

- 
Enablement: Du schulst unsere Entwickler:innen und hilfst ihnen, von Beginn an sichere Projektarchitekturen zu bauen.

ÜBER DICH 
Du bist erfahrener Software Engineer und hast bereits erste oder fundierte Schritte in den Bereichen Führung, Strategie, Security und Compliance gemacht? Bei uns übernimmst Du die Verantwortung, diese Themen auf das nächste Level zu heben.

Dazu bringst du folgendes mit: 

- 
Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Physik oder Elektrotechnik (Master/Promotion von Vorteil).

- 
Leadership & Strategie: Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Führung von Engineering-Teams sowie in strategischer Planung und Incident Handling.

- 
Security & Compliance: Erfahrung in der Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung eines ISMS (ideal VDA/ISA bzw. TISAX).

- 
Engineering-Stack: Fundierte Kenntnisse in UNIX-Systemadministration, Networking, Docker, Kubernetes sowie Programmiererfahrung (idealerweise Go).

- 
Track Record: Ein spürbar hoher Einfluss auf den technischen Erfolg Deiner bisherigen Projekte sowie eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe.

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. 

Bonus-Skills & Interessen 

- 
Erfahrung in der Prüfung von Datenschutz- und Security-Verträgen.

- 
Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (GCP, AWS, Azure), verteilten Systemen (Terraform) und CI/CD-Pipelines.

- 
Vertrautheit mit Observability (Logging, Monitoring, Alerting, Tracing).

ÜBER UNSERE COMMUNITY 

Auf die Frage, warum jemand hier arbeitet, lautet die Antwort oft: „wegen der Menschen“ und „weil ich in meinem Leben noch nie so viel gelernt habe“.

Wir glauben, dass produktive Menschen glückliche Menschen sind. 

In unseren Engineering Hubs in Hamburg und Lissabon triffst du auf Menschen aus der ganzen Welt. 

Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, mit intelligenten Menschen an spannenden Aufgaben zu arbeiten und Projekte von der Idee bis zur Auslieferung umzusetzen – end-to-end. 

Ein wahrer Experte in seinem Fachgebiet wird man nicht über Nacht – dazu braucht es Jahre harter Arbeit und kontinuierliches Lernen. Als ein Member unserer Community wird viel von dir verlangt, und niemand kann die Arbeit für dich übernehmen.

Unser Unternehmen ist ein Ort, an dem du die beste Version deiner selbst werden kannst. 

***Wir bieten keine reinen Remote-Stellen an. Wir arbeiten fünf Tage pro Woche im Büro.

Wir bei MaibornWolff sind ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Expertise. In unserer Delivery-Enabler Gilde arbeiten aktuell elf Scrum Master:innen, Agile Coaches und Delivery Enabler an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland. Unsere Mission: Delivery Enablement als starke, zukunftsfähige Rolle etablieren und Projekt-Teams auch im KI-Wandel wirksam unterstützen. Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Unsere Projekte reichen von einzelnen Entwicklungsteams bis hin zu internationalen Programmen in Branchen wie Automotive, Energie und Public Sector.

Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Aufgaben - Teams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen.
- Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss.
- Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Du schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Zielen und Erwartungen, beseitigst Hindernisse und adressierst mögliche Risiken frühzeitig.
- KI-Agenten integrieren: Du befähigst dein Team zur optimalen Einbindung von KI-Agenten und Tools und hast die damit verbundenen Prozess- und Kommunikationsverschiebungen im Blick. Du begleitest Teams und Kunden souverän durch KI-bedingte Change Prozesse.
- Bereich mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit deiner Delivery Enabler-Gilde entwickelst du unser Rollenverständnis weiter, teilst dein Wissen und treibst relevante Themen voran. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben.

Dein Profil - Ausbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung.
- Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten.
- Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Zudem bist du stark in Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation & Workshop-Design sowie in agilen Metriken und Forecasting. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. 
- Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. Zudem hast du durch deine Projektarbeit ein klares Verständnis zu Wirkweise und möglichen Fallstricken von KI in der Softwareentwicklung gewonnen.

Du bist bereit, bei Bedarf bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche zu reisen – für Workshops, Team-Events oder den direkten Austausch mit Team und Kunden vor Ort.

title: Werkstudent Social Media Marketing & Content Management Wirtschafts- und Finanzbildung (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns Die gemeinnützige Flossbach von Storch Stiftung engagiert sich mit Passion für die Förderung von Wirtschafts- und Finanzbildung. Ihre Aktivitäten sind in drei Bereiche gegliedert: Projektarbeit, Förderung von Wissenschaft, Forschung und Lehre sowie bildungspolitisches Engagement. Zur Unterstützung des Teams bei der Projektarbeit und um noch mehr Menschen zu erreichen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) in Köln mit 15 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche für mindestens 6 Monate.

Deine Aufgaben - Pflege und Ausbau unserer Social-Media-Kanäle (insbesondere Instagram und LinkedIn)
- Konzeption und Umsetzung kreativer Content-Ideen (Text, Bild, Video, Reels) und Serien
- Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Abstimmung des Content Calendars
- Pflege und Aktualisierung unserer Website

- Kenntnisse: Du verfügst über Basiskenntnisse im Bereich Wirtschaft und Finanzen
- Qualifikation: Du bist eingeschriebener Bachelor- oder Masterstudent (m/w/d) der Fachrichtungen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Lehramt, Wirtschaftsjournalismus, Kommunikationswissenschaft oder Marketing
- Darüber hinaus: Du bringst Kreativität und Eigeninitiative mit und zeichnest dich durch eine gewissenhafte, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägten Teamgeist aus
- Sprachen: Du besitzt sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

- Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
- Ausgeprägter Team- und Netzwerkgedanke 
- Strukturiertes Onboarding

Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media, Storytelling und politische Bildungsarbeit – und willst Inhalte und Kampagnen für ein antisemitismuskritisches Bildungsprojekt entwickeln, die junge Menschen erreichen? Dann werde Teil von GermanDream. 

Über uns 
GermanDream ist Deutschlands präsenteste Bildungsbewegung für gelebte Demokratie und Teilhabe. Mit unseren Begegnungsformaten, Bildungsprogrammen sowie durch Vernetzungs- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit vermitteln wir nachhaltig die Werte des Grundgesetzes – im Klassenzimmer, im Alltag und überall dort, wo Menschen zusammenkommen. 

Mit dem Projekt DECODED – Antisemitismus in Popkultur und Medien erweitern wir unsere antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit in Berlin. Gemeinsam mit jüdischen Künstler:innen, Expert:innen und weiteren Kooperationspartner:innen machen wir antisemitische Codes, Sprachbilder und digitale Dynamiken sichtbar. Wir stärken Jugendliche, Lehrkräfte und pädagogische Fachkräfte darin, Antisemitismus zu erkennen, einzuordnen und ihm handlungssicher zu begegnen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Workshops mit Jugendlichen, Qualifizierungen für Lehrkräfte, digitale Inhalte und weitere Formate. 

Deine Rolle 

Du koordinierst und gestaltest die kommunikative Umsetzung des Projekts – von der Redaktions- und Contentplanung bis zur Veröffentlichung: Du schreibst Texte, gestaltest Grafiken, konzipierst Videoformate, begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen, filmst selbst mit und schneidest kurze Videoformate. 

Dabei übersetzt du die fachlichen Themen des Projekts in verständliche, sensible und zielgruppengerechte Inhalte für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle – von Reels, Posts, Sharepics und Story-Formaten bis hin zu Website-Texten, Newsletter-Inhalten und begleitenden Kommunikationsmaterialien für Bildungsangebote und Veranstaltungen.

Du bereitest Einblicke aus der Projektarbeit redaktionell und visuell auf und behältst dabei Redaktionspläne, Termine, Abstimmungen und benötigte Materialien im Blick. 

So trägst du dazu bei, dass die Themen und Angebote des Projektes unterschiedliche Zielgruppen erreichen, jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll sichtbar werden und antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit auch im digitalen Raum Wirkung entfalten kann. 

Was dich in dieser Rolle erwartet 

Content, Redaktion und Storytelling 
- Du planst, erstellst und veröffentlichst Inhalte für die Projektkommunikation für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und unsere Öffentlichkeitsarbeit.

Kampagnen, Social Media und Medienproduktion 
- Du entwickelst und realisierst Kommunikationsformate, Contenstrecken und Kampagnen im Rahmen des Projektes.

- Du bereitest Inhalte, Materialien und Ergebnisse aus dem Projekt für unsere Kommunikationskanäle auf.

- Du greifst relevante Entwicklungen und Debatten in Popkultur, Medien und digitalen Räumen auf und entwickelst daraus passende Kommunikationsansätze.

Zusammenarbeit, Planung und Auswertung 
- Du arbeitest eng mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektmanagement und den eingebundenen Fachrollen zusammen und stimmst fachlich sensible Inhalte eng mit ihnen ab.

title: Associate Director, Social
description:
About WPP Media 

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

3431 - Associate Director, Social - Manchester 

Role Summary and Impact 

As a Associate Director, Social, you will be a core strategic leader responsible for driving the commercial success, operational excellence, and overarching roadmaps for key clients. This role requires an elevated blend of senior paid social expertise, macro strategic vision, and deep commercial acumen. You will assume overarching strategic and commercial accountability for your portfolio, ensuring paid social strategies directly accelerate client business transformation and deliver high-impact commercial results.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior level stakeholders, navigating complex matrix environments and articulating the strategic value of paid social in the broader marketing mix. Leading a multi-tiered team of social managers and specialists, you will foster a culture of creative innovation, rigorous testing, and continuous professional growth. Furthermore, you will play a pivotal role in driving agency growth by supporting with new business pitches, developing Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with platform partners, and establishing yourself as an authoritative voice in the wider media industry.

Key responsibilities: 

Senior Associate Directors have several key areas of focus. These include:

Strategic Leadership & Innovation

- Formulate and execute macro-level paid social strategies aligned with broad client business outcomes (e.g., brand equity, customer lifetime value, market penetration).

- Spearhead innovation across first-party data strategies, privacy-first media planning, conversion APIs (CAPI), and AI-driven social operations.

- Champion cross-channel integration, collaborating closely with search, programmatic, strategy, and creative teams to deliver cohesive omni-channel campaigns.

Commercial Management & Agency Growth

- Maintain commercial oversight across your portfolio, driving organic account growth and ensuring client profitability.

- Develop paid social strategies for new business pitches and RFPs, delivering compelling proposals that win new client accounts.

- Own joint business plans (JBPs) with platform partners (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snap, LinkedIn, Reddit), securing priority alpha/beta testing access for clients.

Client & Executive Stakeholder Relations

- Serve as a senior point of escalation and trusted partner for client and planning leads.

- Deliver high-impact presentations, translating complex technical data into clear, boardroom-ready commercial insights.

People Management & Operational Excellence

- Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing team of social specialists, setting clear KPIs and development plans.

- Oversee team resourcing, capacity planning, and operational workflows to ensure high-quality, faultless campaign delivery across all accounts.

- Establish and govern agency best practice, QA frameworks, and compliance standards across all social channels.

Skills and Experience 

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

- Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. 

- Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust .

- Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise .

Required Skills & Qualifications:

- Experience & Track Record: Proven track record of leading large-scale, enterprise or multi-market client portfolios within a media agency environment.

- Senior Team Leadership: Demonstrable success in leading multi-tiered teams, driving high team retention, talent development, and operational resource planning.

- Commercial & Pitch Capability: Proven record of supporting new business and growing organic client revenue, with a strong understanding of agency commercial models.

- Platform Mastery & JBPs: In-depth, expert-level knowledge of major advertising platforms (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Pinterest Ads Manager, Snap, LinkedIn) alongside experience managing platform partner relationships and JBPs.

- Advanced Measurement & Effectiveness: Proven capability in implementing sophisticated measurement frameworks including incrementality / lift testing.

- Executive Communication & Influence: Outstanding verbal, written, and pitch presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex strategic narratives effortlessly.

- Strategic Portfolio Management: Masterful organizational skills with the ability to balance competing strategic priorities, client accounts, and agency-wide initiatives seamlessly.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications:

- Experience in paid social media.

- Platform certifications (e.g., Meta Blueprint, TikTok Certifications).

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. Awin's Unlock the Clock (UTC) programme is building the evidence base and infrastructure to move measurement beyond last click, using deterministic, CDN/edge-level signals and advanced data connections from publishers to show the full-funnel and AI-discovery influence that today's attribution misses. The value of that dataset scales with the quality and scale of the publishers inside it.

This role exists to acquire and retain those publishers. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media & Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.

This is a new, dedicated role. It is not general publisher account management: the postholder is hired to spearhead these relationships and nothing else.

Key Responsibilities 

Land flagship media partnerships 

- Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin’s deterministic dataset.

- Experience selling or landing something new, a product, model or proposition without an established category, rather than managing an existing book of business.

At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces . 

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

We’re hiring a Senior Manager, HR Operations to lead our HR Operations function across Europe, Asia and LATAM. In this role, you’ll translate global HR strategy into scalable programs, policies and service delivery standards while serving as a trusted advisor on complex governance and risk management across multiple international regions.

As a Senior Manager, HR Operations, you’ll:

- Drive strategy and advisory. You’ll shape the roadmap for international HR operations, aligning global policy with local needs while acting as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across the business.

- Lead governance and compliance. You’ll manage end-to-end compliance across employment contracts, the employee lifecycle, global mobility, benefits, payroll and health and safety protocols across multiple countries.

- Optimize processes. You’ll leverage automation and AI to scale operational efficiency, manage vendor relationships and execute key initiatives like policy overhauls or M&A integrations.

- Develop team talent. You’ll directly manage our HR Operations Manager and coach the broader regional team, setting service-level standards and using metrics to showcase operational impact.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London or Barcelona. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

- Experienced manager. You bring 10+ years of HR operations experience, including at least five years managing teams in a global environment.

- International compliance expertise. You have deep working knowledge of employment law, payroll, benefits and compliance across multiple countries, with strong experience in European regions like the U.K., Spain, Italy and the Netherlands.

- AI fluent. You have proven experience leveraging AI tools to optimize operations and improve workflow efficiency.

- Process builder. You excel at creating scalable, automated processes across complex regulatory landscapes while balancing hands-on execution with long-term strategy.

- Cross-functional collaborator. You build strong partnerships with Legal, Finance and IT, comfortably managing vendor negotiations and influencing senior stakeholders.

Nice-to-Haves

- Multilingual. Conversational or fluent Spanish skills are a plus.

- Certified professional. SHRM-SCP, GPHR or equivalent certifications.

- Advanced degree. Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field.

Our Role 

- Champion work-life harmony . We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. 

- Guarantee autonomy . We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas. 

- Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing. 

- Provide an environment to help you succeed . We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work. 

- Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below— starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range. 

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion. 

Base Salary Range

£75,000 — £125,000 GBP 

Inclusion at Hudl 

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong. 

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities . But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports . 

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The Role 

As a Software Engineer with a minimum of 15 years of experience , you’ll work on our in-house package, 'Miles,' an ERP software for automotive finance, leasing, fleet, and mobility management. This end-to-end solution encompasses front, mid, and back-office functions that can be extensively customized to the customers’ needs through configuration and custom development.

You’ll be part of a multidisciplinary team that includes other developers, business consultants, and testers, covering our end-to-end business flow. You can rely on a broad base of knowledge and expertise.

Every team in Sofico works in an agile way, including scrum, daily stand-ups, and backlog refinement. Additionally, you’ll be joining our Java community, which connects all the Software Engineers within Sofico worldwide to share best practices, code, tips, and tricks.

The Right Fit for the Role 

A passion for developing and building solutions is at the top of our list. As a Software Engineer, it is also key to keep the bigger picture in mind and understand how different elements are intertwined. Problem-solving is one of your strongest abilities, and you approach it methodically. If you are a team player who enjoys collaborating and sharing knowledge , you’re the perfect blend of technical and soft skills.

This position, based in Sydney , offers a hybrid work model: three days in-office and two days remote. 

Candidates must possess full working rights in Australia; sponsorship is not available. 

In your application, elaborate on the following aspects of your career:

- Experience spanning over 15 years 

- Expertise as either a Full Stack Developer or specialized in Back End development

- Proficiency in Java 17, Java EE 7, SQL/JPA, Hibernate 

- Familiarity with Agile Methodology

- Exposure to Automotive, Finance, or Leasing industries

- Experience in Monolithic and Microservices architecture

- Significance in constructing and deploying solutions, both internally and for clients

- Engagement in enhancing current applications, developing new modules, or executing customization projects for clients

- Demonstration of adeptly resolving complex problems in a systematic manner, with project-specific details provided in your application

- Strong communication skills, including client interaction

- Fluency in English, given our international and multicultural environment

About Us 

Discover how Sofico empowers businesses in 27 countries worldwide. With offices in Australia, Belgium, France, Germany, Japan, Mexico, the Netherlands, and the UK, our Sydney-based hub manages clients across Australia and Asia.

Our flagship product, Miles, has completed over 60 successful implementations and earned a solid reputation in automotive finance, leasing, fleet, and mobility management. It's an ERP system renowned for its unmatched flexibility.

Sofico operates at the intersection of rapidly transforming industries: automotive, finance, leasing, and IT. This convergence sparks innovation as our clients pioneer new product offerings, focusing on mobility solutions enabled by connected cars.

Join us—a multinational company with over 600 staff—as we lead the way in industry innovation. Unlock new possibilities with Sofico.

What We Offer 

At Sofico, we welcome you to an international and multicultural company that has been thriving for over 30 years and is doubling in size every five years. Growth is in our DNA, and we strongly uphold our horizontal and open company culture.

- Take control of your career with a focus on personal development.

- Participate in an extensive six-month onboarding program, supported by a dedicated job coach.

- Enjoy continuous opportunities for learning and professional growth.

- Work in a modern, state-of-the-art office that's easily accessible.

- Onsite parking and walking distance from metro.

- Benefit from a competitive salary, flexible office hours.

- Hybrid option to work from home two days a week.

- Access novated leasing options and mobile phone reimbursement.

- Enjoy complimentary coffee, soft drinks, breakfast and fruit

- Participate in team events, including afterwork drinks, BBQs, family days, and company weekends.

If you’re ready to join a dynamic team and take your career to the next level, apply today!

title: Category Manager Packaging & Sustainability
description:
Job Description 

As the Category Manager Packaging & Sustainability, you will report to the Senior International Category Manager for Packaging. You will collaborate on developing and leading the category strategy, drive process improvement initiatives across Australia and New Zealand, and act as a point of escalation for operational matters. We are looking for an ambitious, confident, entrepreneurial, and high-spirited Sustainability & Procurement professional with a strength for data processing, optimization, and reporting.

This role is based in Chippendale, Sydney and reporting to the Senior International Category Manager for Packaging.

You will… 

- Develop, optimize, and align the packaging supplier network and Category Strategy across Australia and New Zealand.

- Create ongoing data analysis and category reviews to drive strategic performance and achieve ambitious targets.

- Support in providing procurement advice, price updates, reporting, invoice approval, replenishment, compliance, and tenders.

- Work closely with suppliers to build strong long-term relationships and execute contracts.

- Project manage and coordinate the preparation of all Non-Financial Reporting and monthly GHG scope data for the ANZ market.

- Drive local sustainability optimization projects, including energy efficiency, renewable energy transition, and packaging innovation.

- Facilitate required Scope 3 carbon reduction initiatives and act as the local point of contact for all regional sustainability work.

You have… 

- 3+ years of strategic procurement, sustainability, supply chain, or commercial consulting experience (ideally in food/FMCG).

- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Sustainability, Economics, or Procurement (or equivalent).

- Sound understanding of Sustainability drivers locally including APCO, and conceptual understanding of ‘How to” impact sustainability, primarily focussed on Packaging.

- Experience in the packaging arena, including material specifications, supplier markets, and running regional tenders.

- Quantitative and analytical expertise, with a solid comfort level using Excel.

You are… 

- Proactive, flexible, and assertive, with a strong ability to take ownership of your work.

- Highly organized and able to prioritize your workload effectively in a fast-paced environment.

- Entrepreneurial, driven by a sense of urgency, and capable of making things happen.

- Comfortable with travel requirements of up to 10% of your time.

What you’ll get in return… 

- The chance to have a significant impact in a leading global food technology company

- Egoless environment, constant learning with room for personal growth

title: Category Management Graduate
description:
The role: What's in the Box 

This is an exciting entry point into strategic procurement at the HelloFresh Group! As a Category Management Graduate for European Herbs , you will get hands-on experience in a live, high-impact category — supporting a portfolio of approximately £10m in annual spend across 6 European markets — with the close guidance and mentorship of an experienced team.

In this role, you will learn the full category management cycle for Herbs: supporting supplier relationships, assisting with tender processes, tracking cost and quality performance, and coordinating cross-functionally with Supply Chain, FSQA, and Product teams. Alongside day-to-day operational support, you will contribute to key strategic initiatives, including the rollout of our new cross-dock supply model in Europe and project support across Fruit Bags, Avocados, and Sustainability.

We are looking for someone analytically sharp, commercially curious, and eager to learn fast. You don’t need years of procurement experience — just the drive to learn, strong attention to detail, and a passion for fresh produce and supply chains!

What you’ll do: The Recipe 

Category Management Support 

- 
Assist with day-to-day procurement activities for the European Herbs category, including monitoring order status, tracking shortage responses, and assisting with quality coordination.

- 
Support the execution of the Herbs category strategy, gathering market data and helping track supplier performance and supply risks across 6 markets.

- 
Support tender processes for the category — assisting with data preparation, supplier briefings, and preliminary commercial analysis.

- 
Help maintain accurate cost reporting, invoice tracking, and administrative supplier data for the Herbs category.

Supplier Collaboration 

- 
Act as a secondary point of contact for Herbs suppliers across Europe, helping manage routine operational queries and administrative follow-ups.

- 
Assist the Teamlead in preparing materials for supplier meetings, joint business planning sessions, and contract discussions.

- 
Track and report on supplier performance metrics (OTIF, quality, and sustainability KPIs), escalating potential risks proactively.

Cross-Functional & Strategic Projects 

- 
Support the cross-dock supply chain pilot in Europe by helping coordinate communication between Procurement, Supply Chain Operations, and suppliers.

- 
Provide analytical and coordination support across strategic initiatives in Fruit Bags, Avocados, and Fruit & Sustainability.

- 
Collaborate with internal teams (Product, FSQA, Operations) to ensure procurement documentation and alignment remain smooth.

- 
Research and monitor market dynamics in herbs and fresh produce — such as seasonality, weather risks, and pricing trends — bringing valuable insights to team discussions.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients 

Education & Background 

- 
Recently graduated from a Bachelor's or Master's program in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.

- 
Previous internship, placement, or academic project experience in an analytical or commercial environment is a plus (direct procurement experience is not required).

- 
A genuine interest in food, agriculture, or global supply chains — curiosity about where ingredients come from will serve you well here!

Skills & Mindset 

- 
Analytically Minded: Comfortable working with data in Excel/Google Sheets, analyzing costs, and presenting findings clearly.

- 
Organized & Proactive: Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple small tasks, and eagerness to take initiative.

- 
Commercially Curious: Eager to understand how pricing works, why supply chains move, and how strategic decisions impact business outcomes.

- 
Adaptable & Collaborative: Thrives in a fast-paced, international team environment and eager to learn on the go.

- 
Languages: Excellent written and spoken English is required; fluency in a second European language (French, German, Dutch, Spanish, or Italian) is a strong advantage.

- 
Travel: Willingness to travel internationally up to 25% of the time if required for project support.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

What we offer: The Toppings 

- 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes

- Company pension scheme

- Gym membership

- Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)

- Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme

- Dog friendly office! (London site only)

- Nursery support scheme

- Cycle to work scheme

- Group Life Assurance

Are you up for the challenge? 

Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.

Please note that we will be unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. 

You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager.

If you are currently a HelloFresh employee, please make sure you have discussed your application with your Line Manager.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (EMEA)
description:
About Smartcat 

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world's leading enterprises.

We're on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren't generic copilots. They're fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we're scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM 

You'll own technical success across the full customer lifecycle for Smartcat's biggest customers — from pre-sales discovery through implementation, adoption, and expansion. This is a forward-facing, outcome-owning role with full autonomy to make your customers successful: you'll be their point of contact and trusted advisor, building the AI-powered workflows and integrations that drive real ARR, while directly influencing product roadmap priorities along the way.

MISSION 

Own technical success across the full customer lifecycle — from pre-sales workflow discovery to implementation, adoption, and expansion — driving ARR by delivering measurable outcomes and building AI-powered workflows that accelerate Agent Platform adoption, improve multilingual quality, and maximize long-term customer value.

OUTCOMES 

- Lead end-to-end technical execution across the customer journey, from pre-sales discovery and demos through deployment and value realization

- Build and deploy AI-powered workflows — prompts, agent skills, and configurations — that improve multilingual content quality, speed, and efficiency

- Own integrations and automation that embed Smartcat into enterprise systems (CMS, DAM, PIM, commerce platforms such as AEM, Drupal, SFCC)

- Serve as technical lead for customer deployments, owning validation, testing, and go-live readiness

- Drive post-sale adoption and enablement, quantify outcomes and value realization, and identify expansion opportunities based on technical success

- Partner with CX, Product, Engineering, and Account teams to close the feedback loop and influence roadmap priorities

HOW YOU'LL RAMP 

By Day 30: 

- Learn Smartcat's Agent Platform, workflow architecture, and integration capabilities (APIs, connectors, middleware)

- Shadow pre-sales discovery calls and demos to understand how technical solutions are scoped and sold

- Meet your GTM Account, CX, Product, and Engineering partners and get oriented in current customer deployments

By Day 60: 

- Own pre-sales technical discovery independently on at least one opportunity, translating requirements into a solution plan

- Be building and testing AI-powered workflows (prompts, agent skills, configurations) for a live customer

- Contribute to at least one integration effort with an enterprise system (CMS, DAM, PIM, or commerce platform)

By Day 90: 

- Serve as technical lead on a customer deployment from discovery through go-live, owning validation and readiness

- Have submitted technical feedback or bug reports that inform Product/Engineering roadmap decisions

- Be actively supporting post-sale adoption and identifying expansion opportunities based on technical success with your customers

WHAT YOU'VE ACCOMPLISHED 

- BS/MS in engineering, analytics, or a related field, with 10+ years in technical deployment, implementation management, or technical account management of SaaS products at Enterprise customers

- Experience with REST APIs, GitHub, AI SaaS workflows, enterprise change management, and technical solution design/integrations

- Skill in troubleshooting complex implementation issues and creating custom solutions with software like LMS, CMS, PIMs, DAMs

- Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to both technical and executive audiences

- Strong negotiation, influencing, and client relationship management skills

- A proven ability to deliver post-sale support, training, and adoption initiatives

- An entrepreneurial mindset with curiosity, problem-solving ability, and a collaborative approach

- Willingness to travel up to 40%

Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far 

- A global, connected team 
We're a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you're based, you'll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.

- Be part of an AI Native Organization 
We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you'll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.

- Innovating a $100 Billion industry 
Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.

- Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together 
We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn't for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here. 

- Smartcat Culture Code : Where Diversity Meets High Performance 
At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

title: Senior Account Manager (French-speaking)
description:
Who are we 

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location 

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms. 

About the Team 

We are looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team , which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers, with a particular focus on French-speaking stakeholders and organisations . You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio .

What You Will Do 

- Own account commercial outcomes: Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

- Protect retention and renewal outcomes: Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.

- Drive account expansion: Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas.

- Develop account strategies: Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration.

- Lead consultative customer conversations: Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment.

- Navigate complex enterprise sales processes: Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes.

- Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting: Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts.

- Use AI to elevate your work: Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact.

What You Must Have 

- Full account lifecycle ownership: +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a quota-based B2B SaaS environment.

- Proven commercial outcomes: A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion.

- Professional fluency in French , including the ability to lead customer conversations, presentations, and commercial negotiations in French.

- Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders , and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value.

- Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation.

- Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities.

- Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions.

- Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.

It's a Plus If You Have 

- Experience managing or selling to enterprise customers in the French market, regardless of where you are based.

- Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers.

- Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software.

- Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees.

- Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks.

Our Benefits 

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.

🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

🏢 Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

🖥️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.

🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

🤝 Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.

title: Treasury Manager (ALM)
description:
Build with us 

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact 

Treasury is where Mollie's balance sheet takes shape, this team makes sure that our balance sheet is safe, well-funded and resilient. You, as Treasury Manager, will be one of the first people building the Asset & Liability Management (ALM) function for Mollie.

This is a genuine 0-to-1 role. There is no legacy ALM framework to maintain, no existing ILAAP to update, no established models to inherit. You'll help design and build the liquidity risk framework, the interest rate and credit spread risk approach, and the funding and balance sheet strategy. Your work will feed directly into Mollie’s licence application and, once authorised, into how Mollie actually manages its liquidity and funding risks.

You'll work closely with our product teams, Finance, and Risk Domains and your analysis will be seen by senior leadership and, eventually, by our regulator. As Mollie moves from application to operation, your scope will grow from building the framework to running it.

What you'll ship 

- Build and own the core building blocks of Mollie liquidity risk framework, including the ILAAP, LCR/NSFR monitoring, and liquidity stress testing.

- Develop Mollie’s approach to interest rate risk and credit spread risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB), from risk identification through to models, limits and hedging strategy.

- Contribute to the design of Mollie’s funding and balance sheet strategy, including deposit mix, funding diversification and balance sheet construction.

- Build the Contingency Funding Plan and related early-warning indicators, so Mollie knows exactly what to do under stress before it needs to.

- Produce clear, well-documented policies, methodologies and models that will stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors, and Mollie's own second and third lines of defense.

- Support senior leadership (ALCO or its future equivalent) with the analysis, reporting and recommendations it needs to make sound balance sheet decisions.

- Partner with Risk, Finance and our external advisors, to make sure Treasury's frameworks are consistent with Mollie’s wider risk appetite and governance.

What you'll bring 

- Around 5+ years of experience in Treasury, ALM or balance sheet risk management, ideally within a bank, though experience in a fintech, PSP or consultancy building similar frameworks is also relevant.

- Solid working knowledge of liquidity risk (LCR/NSFR, ILAAP) and/or interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB). You don't need to be deep in both, but you understand how they connect to the balance sheet as a whole.

- Comfort building models and frameworks from a blank page. You're not looking for a well-worn playbook, you're excited to write the first one.

- Strong quantitative and Excel/financial modelling skills, with the discipline to document your logic clearly enough that someone else, including a regulator, can follow it.

- The ability to explain complex balance sheet risk topics clearly to non-specialists, and the confidence to defend your recommendations to senior stakeholders.

- Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of this work that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgment and design.

Grow your way 

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy.

AI at Mollie

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance and banking with us.

title: Network Developer
description:
Senior Network Developer 

About Share 

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role 

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do 

- Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

- Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

- Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

- Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

- Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

- Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

- Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

- Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate 

- 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

- Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

- Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

- Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

- You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

- You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

- AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

- You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

- A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have 

- Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

- Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

- Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

- 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

- Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

- Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

- DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits 

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)
