title: Enseignante Chercheuse ou Enseignant Chercheur (Maître de conférences)  Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs en CDI à IMT Nord Europe
description:
INTITULÉ : « Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs ». 

SPÉCIALITÉS : « Qualité de l'air intérieur, Physico-chimie de l'air, Performance énergétique et environnementale des bâtiments ». 

ÉTABLISSEMENT D'AFFECTATION : 

École Nationale Supérieure Mines-Télécom Lille Douai dont le nom d'usage est IMT Nord Europe.

Direction / Service : Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Énergie Environnement (CERI EE)

Responsable hiérarchique : Directrice du CERI Énergie Environnement

Catégorie : Agent de catégorie A ou contractuel cadre de gestion de catégorie II

Nature du poste : CDI

Lieu de travail : Site de Douai. Des déplacements sur les autres sites de l'École sont à prévoir

CONTEXTE 

École sous tutelle du ministère de l'économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, et école de l'Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l'innovation et les créations d'entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l'Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1h30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l'ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l'ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d'enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s'appuie sur plus de 20 000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d'excellence dans les domaines suivants :

• Énergie Environnement

• Systèmes Numériques

• Matériaux et Procédés

L'École dispose également d'antennes à Dunkerque, Valenciennes et Alençon.

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l'Ecole : www.imt-nord-europe.fr 

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Énergie Environnement (CERI EE) ( https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/ ).

Le CERI EE développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l'efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. Le CERI est structuré en trois axes thématiques : EFT (Énergie, Fluides et Transferts), OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques) et QEI (Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs).

L'axe thématique QEI porte sur l'étude, l'identification et la caractérisation des sources de polluants dans les espaces clos et/ou confinés, l'analyse des interactions entre l'air intérieur et les matériaux, ainsi que l'étude de l'influence des environnements sur l'exposition et le bien-être des occupants. Les enjeux scientifiques traités couvrent plusieurs échelles, depuis l'intégration de matériaux et de systèmes énergétiques innovants jusqu'à leurs impacts sur les espaces intérieurs et leurs occupants. Dans un contexte marqué par le changement climatique et des exigences croissantes en termes de QEI et d'efficacité énergétique, une attention particulière est portée aux stratégies d'adaptation et d'atténuation, ainsi qu'aux rôles du comportement des occupants et des différentes sources d'exposition.

Ce poste vise à renforcer et développer l'axe thématique QEI au sein du CERI. La QEI intègre l'étude de multiples paramètres de confort (température, hygrométrie, bruit, luminosité) et de composition de l'air dans les environnements clos (logements, espaces de travail, transports, etc.), afin d'assurer bien-être et santé des occupants. Ces environnements doivent concilier les transitions environnementales et énergétiques avec la qualité de l'air et le confort des occupants.

L'ambition est de consolider le positionnement d'IMT Nord Europe dans ce domaine, avec une synergie entre recherche et formation. Il s'agit de renforcer un réseau de recherche et d'enseignement interdisciplinaire sur cette thématique en réponse à des attentes sociétales, des pouvoirs publics et des acteurs socio-économiques. Le recrutement s'effectue sur un projet de recherche et d'enseignement porté par un ou une titulaire de doctorat et s'inscrivant dans cette stratégie.

Dans ce cadre, IMT Nord Europe recrute un Enseignant Chercheur ou une Enseignante Chercheuse dont les missions sont décrites ci-après.

MISSIONS : 

Sous l'autorité de la directrice du CERI EE, le ou la titulaire du poste participera aux activités d'enseignement, de recherche et de transfert de technologie :

Activités de recherche et de transfert de technologie : 

Dans le cadre général de la stratégie scientifique précédemment décrite, les recherches auront pour objectif de développer des connaissances scientifiques et des outils avec pour finalité l'amélioration de la qualité de l'air des environnements intérieurs (en particulier mais de manière non exclusive dans les bâtiments), de la santé, du confort et de l'exposition des occupants tout en accompagnant les transformations du cadre bâti nécessaires à la transition écologique et énergétique.

Les thèmes de recherche attendus pourraient porter sur :

• La préservation de la QEI face au changement climatique et à la nécessaire adaptation à ce changement ;

• Les contributions des environnements intérieurs à l'exposition des occupants en intégrant les moyens d'évaluation et d'optimisation de l'exposition et du confort des occupants ;

• Les impacts de la sobriété énergétique des systèmes énergétiques innovants et durables sur la QEI.

La personne recrutée devra :

• Développer une activité de recherche de haut niveau dans le domaine de la QEI,

• Initier, conduire et coordonner des projets de recherche régionaux, nationaux et à terme européens,

• Développer des actions de recherche contractuelle et de transfert de technologie en partenariat avec des acteurs du monde socio-économique,

• Créer des passerelles entre les axes thématiques du CERI EE et les autres CERI en lien avec les domaines d'excellence d'IMT Nord Europe et de l'Institut Mines Télécom,

• Encadrer des doctorants, des post-doctorants et des étudiants de Master,

• Préparer une Habilitation à Diriger des Recherches,

• Participer au rayonnement de la thématique en lien étroit avec les autres collègues du CERI, notamment à l'international,

• Publier dans les conférences et revues de référence du domaine, et participer à l'organisation d'événements scientifiques.

Activités d'enseignement : 

Le CERI EE intervient dans l'ensemble des cursus Ingénieur. Il porte notamment deux des huit parcours de spécialité de l'école : GE (Génie Energétique) et GERI (Génie de l'Environnement et Risques Industriels) en formation initiale et une formation en apprentissage en Génie Energétique. Le CERI EE est également porteur de deux Mastères Spécialisés (MS) : le MS Bâtiment à Energie Positive, et le MS en Management des Risques Professionnels et Technologiques. Le CERI EE assure également des activités d'enseignements en formation continue, notamment en lien avec la QEI. Enfin, le CERI EE a pour projet de développer à court terme un projet de Master International « Engineering of Sustainable and Healthy Built Environment » dans lequel la personne recrutée viendra en appui aux personnes en charge du développement de cette formation.

La personne recrutée devra :

• En lien avec le montage en cours d'un Master International Engineering of Sustainable and Healthy Built Environment, proposer un projet d'enseignement qui viendra, en partie, en appui des pilotes de ce Master pour notamment :

– Contribuer à la finalisation pédagogique et à la promotion de cette nouvelle formation,

– Contribuer aux enseignements et tutorats des étudiants du master. En s'appuyant sur l'alliance européenne EuLiST, ce Master vise à aligner activités de recherche et d'enseignement. Ces enseignements devront être dispensés en anglais.

• Contribuer aux activités d'enseignement dans les différentes formations proposées à l'Ecole, dans son domaine de spécialité (QEI) et dans des domaines connexes (ex : chimie, thermodynamique, ...) en fonction de son champ disciplinaire ;

• Contribuer aux activités pédagogiques sur l'ensemble des formations portées par IMT Nord Europe, en fonction de ses domaines d'expertise et des besoins pédagogiques ;

• Contribuer à la mise en place d'innovations pédagogiques intégrant les outils numériques (MOOC, classe inversée, etc.),

• S'investir dans les activités d'encadrement pédagogique (projets, stages, tutorats) et de sélection (concours).

PROFIL : (Prérequis/ Diplôme) 

La personne retenue devra être titulaire d'un doctorat et justifier d'une expérience de recherche dans le domaine de la Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs ou dans une discipline contribuant à son étude, telle que la physico-chimie de l'air intérieur, l'évaluation de l'exposition individuelle, ou encore la performance énergétique et environnementale des bâtiments. Le profil recherché repose avant tout sur de solides compétences expérimentales, complété par une bonne compréhension des enjeux et des outils de simulation de la qualité de l'air intérieur. Ainsi, une aptitude à développer des recherches aux interfaces disciplinaires est recherchée afin d'articuler les problématiques d'exposition et de confort des occupants avec les caractéristiques des bâtiments et les stratégies d'amélioration de leur performance énergétique.

Il est attendu du candidat ou de la candidate de :

• Démontrer une capacité à appréhender les enjeux multidisciplinaires liés à la QEI, avec une ouverture scientifique permettant d'intégrer des problématiques variées et de travailler aux interfaces disciplinaires ;

• Faire preuve d'une aptitude à développer de nouvelles compétences dans des champs disciplinaires complémentaires à son profil initial ;

• Posséder une bonne compréhension des enjeux industriels et sociétaux liés aux thématiques du poste ;

• Attester d'une activité scientifique de qualité, traduite par des publications dans des revues et conférences à fort impact, idéalement en collaboration avec des équipes internationales ;

• Présenter, si possible, une expérience dans le montage et la conduite de projets financés sur appels à projets compétitifs, avec obtention de financements externes ou démontrer une aptitude à coordonner des actions collectives ;

• Montrer une appétence pour la transmission des connaissances et l'enseignement en démontrant si possible une expérience en termes d'innovations pédagogiques (MOOC, enseignement hybride, méthodes actives) ;

• Faire preuve de compétences organisationnelles et relationnelles de manière à interagir efficacement avec l'ensemble des interlocuteurs (enseignement, recherche, support technique et autres partenaires industriels notamment) ;

• Faire preuve d'autonomie, d'initiative, d'esprit collectif et d'un sens affirmé du service public ;

• Disposer de solides compétences en communication scientifique et en vulgarisation, en français comme en anglais.

Une expérience internationale, une participation à des projets collaboratifs ainsi qu'un premier réseau au sein des communautés académiques et/ou industrielles constitueront des atouts appréciés. La préparation de l'HDR s'inscrira dans la perspective de l'évolution de carrière de la personne recrutée.

La résidence administrative est fixée à Douai. Des déplacements réguliers sont à prévoir sur l'ensemble des implantations de l'école notamment pour l'enseignement mais aussi de manière plus générale au national et à l'international dans le cadre des activités de recherche.

That's your world.
As a Data Center Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.

Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter. 

What convinces us Your personality, paired with:
- 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance

- Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
- Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
- Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

title: Senior Product Manager, Core Product
description:
About us 

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the self-serve product experience for our SMB customers: small to medium brands selling on Shopify and beyond. The proposition for this segment is unbuilt, the squad is yours to shape, and you'll own the slice of ARR that comes with it. Working closely with engineers, designers, and AI researchers, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships

Location: Paris, hybrid 3 days in the office. We offer relocation support

About the role

- Own a real slice of the self-serve product. From idea to shipped feature, you will build and execute the roadmap that solves problems for our users.

- Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the user problem, then partner with design and engineering to ship work that feels effortless.

- Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue.

- Stay close to the user. Talk to e-commerce sellers every week, and feed what you hear directly into roadmap decisions.

- Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won’t need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

About You

- You've shipped products you can defend in detail. Five+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you can name the user problem, what you owned personally vs. the team, and the measured outcome.

- You've built B2B SaaS for self-serve customers. You know the mechanics of self-serve growth, retention, and pricing, not just enterprise sales cycles.

- AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

- You have demonstrable product taste. You can show specific work where the details matter and explain the calls you made, including the ones you'd make differently now.

- You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

- You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

- You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

Nice to have: experience building creative tools or any product where craft and visual quality matter; an understanding of photography or videography; entrepreneurial experience (you've started, built, or run something).

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

🚀 CONTEXTE & ENJEUX STRATÉGIQUES

Au sein de Decathlon Digital, l'équipe People Data engage une initiative majeure : transformer l'expérience de nos 100 000 collaborateurs par l'intégration de l'IA Générative et Agentique.

Face à la fragmentation de l'écosystème RH dans plus de 70 pays, notre ambition est de construire une couche de simplification en s’appuyant sur les nouvelles solutions que proposent l’IA. Il s'agit d'une couche d'intelligence centralisée et agnostique des outils, capable d'interagir avec l'ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, University, ...) pour faire évoluer nos interfaces d'une logique de consultation vers une logique d'action.

Dans ce cadre, nous développons DaiLY , notre agent conversationnel RH. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers à accéder instantanément à une information fiable, sourcée à partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People.

Déjà déployé avec succès en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage à l'échelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des évaluations, amélioration continue de nos modèles et de leurs qualités et déploiement et intégration d’agents autonomes RH. 

Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e " Builder " : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps.

🎯 VOTRE MISSION

Nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer confirmé(e) pour participer activement à l'industrialisation et au développement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins métiers RH en fonctionnalités IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.

Pour relever ce défi, vous évoluerez au sein d'un collectif dédié , en collaboration directe avec d'autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d'architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximité vous permettra d'assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l'implémentation technique.

Vous aurez notamment un rôle clé dans l'évolution de DaiLY : passer d'un modèle de simple consultation (Q&A) à un véritable système agentique transactionnel capable de déclencher des actions concrètes (ex : poser des congés dans Workday, s'inscrire à des formations via Decathlon University).

🛠 VOS RESPONSABILITES 

- Développement Agentique & Fonctionnalités

- Participer à l'extension des capacités de DaiLY vers des actions d'écriture (write actions) en implémentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).

- Implémenter des stratégies avancées de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les règles spécifiques au domaine RH.

- Contribuer à l'optimisation des coûts, de la latence et de l'efficacité globale du système en lien avec les équipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.

- Qualité, Évaluation & Observabilité (LLMOps)

- Développer et maintenir la couche de qualité du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine).

- Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des réponses et la vérification des citations pour garantir la traçabilité vers une source de vérité.

- Mettre en place des pipelines d'observabilité robustes pour l'évaluation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow).

- Coder des évaluateurs automatiques basés sur des golden datasets pour itérer sereinement et prévenir les régressions avant chaque mise en production.

- Intégrer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour protéger le système et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.

- Sécurité, Cloisonnement & Déploiement International

- Access Management (ACLs) : Implémenter une gestion granulaire et dynamique des droits d'accès au niveau de l'indexation et du retrieval, garantissant qu'un collaborateur n'accède strictement qu'aux documents RH de son périmètre.

- Isolation & Multi-tenancy : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de filtrage par métadonnées (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et/ou des modèles) pour assurer une étanchéité parfaite des données entre les différentes sociétés fiscales, entités légales et géographies de Decathlon.

- Support Multilingue : Contribuer à l'architecture d'internationalisation de DaiLY en adaptant les pipelines RAG, l'embedding et l'inférence pour maintenir un haut niveau de performance et de pertinence sur une grande diversité de langues.

- Produit & Impact Business

- Aider à l'analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l'impact de DaiLY.

- Traduire, avec l'appui de la Product Manager et du Lead, les enjeux métier en comportements de modèles et en métriques de succès.

🧠 PROFIL RECHERCHE

Nous recherchons un profil justifiant a minima d’une première expérience. 

- Expérience : Profil confirmé justifiant de plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en entreprise (hors stages et alternances) en AI Engineering, ML Engineering ou Software Engineering orienté IA. Vous justifiez également d'au moins une expérience concrète et réussie de mise en production d'un système GenAI ou agentique.

- Stack Technique : Solide maîtrise de Python, de l'écosystème GCP / Vertex AI, et des frameworks d'orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou ADK).

- Expertise LLM & Agentique : Solide maîtrise des architectures RAG (recherche vectorielle, Vertex AI Vector Search, gestion avancée de métadonnées), mais surtout des concepts techniques agentiques : function/tool-calling, boucles de raisonnement (ReAct, etc.), orchestration de workflows multi-agents, structured output et gestion du contexte/mémoire.

- Qualité & Évaluation : Capacité à diagnostiquer une réponse incorrecte (problème de modèle, de retrieval ou de données) et appétence pour l'observabilité applicative (SQL / BigQuery / MLflow).

- Langues : Anglais professionnel courant (environnement international).

Les plus : 

- Connaissance technique approfondie des protocoles A2A (Agent-to-Agent) et MCP.

- Expérience de traitement multimodal de documents ou dans des écosystèmes SIRH (ex: Workday).

- Compréhension technique des enjeux de sécurité (RBAC, ACLs, RGPD) appliqués aux LLMs.

- Connaissance des architectures microservices et conception d'APIs.

🎁 CE QUE NOUS PROPOSONS

- L'opportunité de développer un produit d'IA agentique de pointe avec un impact direct sur le quotidien de 100 000 collaborateurs.

- Un environnement technologique premium (Stack Google Cloud / Vertex AI / Databricks).

- Une politique de télétravail flexible (2 jours par semaine en remote, le reste dans nos bureaux à Paris - Canal de l’Ourcq).

- Une culture du delivery axée sur l'autonomie, l'intelligence collective et la montée en compétences (accompagnement par un Lead, certifications, formations).

- Des avantages attractifs (primes mensuelles/trimestrielles, actionnariat salarié).

- Une ambiance résolument tournée vers le sport (nombreuses corpos, tests produits, pauses déjeuner sportives ou non, …)

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Who are we? 

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role? 

In this role as a Solutions Architect (SA) for Cohere in the Southern Europe region, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s business across France, Spain, Italy and the wider European region. You will partner with account executives, our partner ecosystem and executive leadership to help the region's leading enterprises and public institutions adopt AI securely and at scale, building on Cohere's success with organisations in defence, financial services, Telecommunications, Energy and the public sector.

SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits:

- Technical experts in the field

- Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues

- Product evangelists of Cohere technology

- Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI

Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products.

In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers.

You will own the customer's technical narrative end to end, from discovery and architecture to pilot results and business case, and bring structured customer feedback back to our Product and Engineering teams.

A typical day at Cohere might include: 

- Leading the technical talk track on customer calls.

- Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments.

- Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology.

- Working with customer executives to prioritise use cases, define success metrics and build the business case for AI adoption.

- Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots inside their stack

- Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere.

- Collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure our offering matches the customers’ needs.

- Working closely with our partners to develop a strategy for enabling and accelerating their customers.

This might be for you if you have some of the following: 

- 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles where you both built and advised, such as consulting data scientist, forward deployed engineer or deployment strategist, or solutions architect, taking AI or data solutions from executive problem framing to production.

- A passion for Agentic AI, and a practical understanding of where LLMs deliver value in production, and where they don't.

- Solid grounding in ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, retrieval etc.) and the ability to design evaluation frameworks for customer pilots.

- Excellent communication skills - you can toggle seamlessly between presenting to CEOs, and getting in the weeds with technical audiences.

- You thrive in ambiguity and can put high-impact structure and processes in place where none exist.

- Comfortable working with Python and Assistive Coding tools

- Preferred: Fluency in French, Spanish or Italian 

- Must have: Professional fluency in English (business and technical) 

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: 

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work: 

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

title: Account Manager
description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? 

Are you interested in helping international brands/organisations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect’s vision is to be the world's premier provider of global language and business solutions. We will accomplish this by applying our values, passion, dedication, and innovation to help our clients improve their businesses and achieve their goals on a global scale. Our services portfolio covers everything from business support services such as interpretation, multicultural and digital marketing, SEO and website globalisation to multimedia work, video, e-learning and training, and legal support services. All services and client partnerships are aided by best-in-breed software platforms, specialised in optimising business processes. 

That’s enough about us – what about you? 

We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore, the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success. 

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you! We have over 140 offices worldwide, but this particular opportunity is to be based in one of our offices in Paris, London or Milan. 

Position Summary: 

The main focus of this role is sales and business development focused on the Life Sciences industry and requires a person with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive attitude in outbound sales. 

Key position responsibilities: 

- Develop prospective clients through several strategies including internet sourcing, trade show lists, referrals, various professional directories and personal investigation 

- Foster and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (trade shows, regional organisations, etc.) 

- Responsible for growing new business from existing clients, including working closely with senior leadership to expand current relationships and up-sell the TransPerfect portfolio 

- Creatively problem solve to improve current new business development strategy 

- Negotiate rates and deadlines with prospective and current clients 

- Educate prospective and existing clients regarding the translation process, including TransPerfect’s rates, justification for turnaround time, and competitors’ information 

- Liaise with production to ensure that all jobs are handled appropriately and with keen attention to detail, resulting in a perfect product 

- Consistently follow up with clients to ensure their satisfaction with delivery, quality and customer service 

- Understand all industries that TransPerfect markets to including industry leaders, current events and any other pertinent data 

- Perform other special projects or duties when required 

Essential skills required: 

- Commit to a high level of integrity and service 

- Superior written and spoken communication skills in French & English 

- Deliver quality work 

- Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations 

- Owning your performance and taking responsibility 

- Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment 

- Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect 

- Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures 

- Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers 

- Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives 

- Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions 

- Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems 

Experience required: 

- Problem solving mindset 

- Strong interpersonal skills with prior experience in a client facing role 

- Strong written and spoken communication skills 

- Good analytical skills with attention to detail 

- Most importantly, the ideal candidate must demonstrate ability to: multitask in a fast-paced environment, work well with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures, build strategic relationships with clients and co-workers, work as part of a team, take active measures to solve problems and commit to a high level of service

title: Strategic Partner Account Manager DACH
description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. 

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. 

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. 

At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. 

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. 

We are seeking a driven and dynamic individual to join our DACH Partnerships team in the Paris office. You will play a pivotal role in our regional growth and development of one of our largest partner ecosystems.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc). Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region.

Key Responsibilities: 

Partner Recruitment & Onboarding: 

- 
Identify, recruit, and onboard new Channel Partners (or System Integrators) that align with our strategic objectives and target markets.

- 
Develop and implement effective partner onboarding programs to ensure rapid ramp-up and productivity.

- 
Educate partners on Aircall's products, services, value proposition, and sales processes.

Partner Relationship Management: 

- Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders within partner organizations.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, addressing their needs, challenges, and opportunities.

- 
Conduct regular business reviews with partners to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and develop joint action plans.

Revenue Generation & Sales Enablement: 

- 
Develop and execute joint business plans with partners to achieve mutually agreed-upon revenue targets.

- 
Provide ongoing sales enablement, training, and support to partners, including product updates, competitive intelligence, and sales collateral.

- 
Collaborate with internal sales teams to ensure seamless hand-off and co-selling opportunities with partners.

- 
Track and report on partner performance metrics, including pipeline, closed deals, and revenue attribution.

title: Associate Account Manager (Paris)
description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty, 

wellness and self-care 

About Fresha 

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC. 

Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions. 

Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management. 

The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google. 

Role overview 

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business. 

Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform. 

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact. 

To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées. 

Commercial Growth 

- Engagement - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform.

- Sales Cycle - Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution.

- Market Trends - Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions.

Relationship Building 

- Partnering - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption.

- Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications.

- Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits.

- Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey.

- Collaboration - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases.

- Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform.

- This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver. 

What we are looking for 

- Experience - 1-2 Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role

- Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities

- Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets

- Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes

- Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve

- Tele-prospecting - Previous experience in an outbound call environment or a related sales position preferred

- Communication - Excellent and proven written, verbal and presentation skills

- Innovative - Creative thinking and problem-solving mindset

- Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder

- Team Player - Happy to roll sleeves up and assist the team when required

- Initiative - Ability to self-starter with a proactive approach

Added Bonus 

- Bi-lingual - Fluency in English and another language

- Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry

- At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview Process 

- Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)

- Skills & Experience - In-Person interview with Team Leads (30 mins)

- Presentation - In-Person interview with General Manager.

We aim to complete the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks . 

- Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe

Inclusive workforce 

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable. 

We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment. 

We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. 

If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

title: Infrastructure & Security Lead
description:
About Luo 

Luo is one of the fastest-growing FX and cross-border payments companies in Africa. We help African businesses pay their international suppliers faster, more transparently, and more competitively than traditional solutions.

After becoming a leading player in a few markets in record time, we are looking to grow our engineering team and keep expanding the financial infrastructure for FX and cross-border payments in Africa.

Role overview 

As Infrastructure & Security Lead, you will join a small team of experienced engineers and be responsible for evolving our cloud infrastructure and its security controls. You will work directly with our CTO to build the foundations that keep LuoPay secure, reliable, and compliant as we scale. The scope covers our GCP infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tooling, as well as the security and compliance program that regulators, partners, and customers depend on.

Key responsibilities 

- Analyze our infrastructure and map security risks.

- Write clear, concise design documents to share infrastructure targets with the rest of the engineering team.

- Use Terraform to evolve our GCP infrastructure.

- Use GCP-native security tooling to protect our network, services and databases within GCP.

- Automate security testing within our delivery pipelines.

- Research and onboard new tools to improve our reliability and security posture.

- Work alongside our CTO to implement our security and compliance framework.

What we are looking for

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Zurich, Switzerland
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity. 

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview 

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What Yo u’ ll Do 

- Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API

- Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break

- Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on

- Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for

- Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat

- Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us

- Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have 

- Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)

- Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud

- A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created

- A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone

- The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it

- Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it

- A preference for being corrected over being right

- Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments

- Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process 

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

What We Offer 

- A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

- A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

- Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

- The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

- Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

- The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

- An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Switzerland Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-160,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Think you’re a good fit for this job? 

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. 
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 

Refer them!

With millions of diners, 60,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job 
As an Account Executive in Zurich, you will drive the expansion of our dining network by acquiring new restaurant partners through a consultative sales approach. You will act as a trusted advisor to top restaurants, demonstrating how our industry-leading front-of-house management and online reservation technology can optimize their revenue potential. In this remote position with up to 60% domestic travel, you will play a crucial role in empowering restaurants to focus on their teams and guests. Your strategic efforts will directly influence our market presence and the continued success of the hospitality industry in your territory.

Responsibilities 

- Identify, target, and approach prospective restaurant customers within your assigned territory to drive revenue and consistently exceed acquisition targets.

- Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with elite restaurant partners, acting as a strategic consultant to challenge their business perspectives and offer industry insights.

- Deliver high-quality, customized, data-driven demonstrations of our solutions in person and online to address specific partner needs.

- Develop comprehensive business plans to define selling strategies, overcome competitive objections, and drive long-term business value.

- Utilise Salesforce effectively to manage your territory, forecast sales activity, process contracts, and stay organized.

- Gather and present valuable customer feedback to product and marketing teams while maintaining visibility in the hospitality industry through networking.

Minimum Qualifications 

- 5+ years of experience in business-to-business (B2B) enterprise sales.

- Native-level proficiency in Swiss German and business-level proficiency in English.

- Native Italian or French proficiency is a plus!

- Proven track record of goal-oriented sales performance, including outbound lead generation and pipeline management.

- Proficiency with CRM software (such as Salesforce) and Google Workspace.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment with up to 60% domestic travel.

Preferred Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

- Prior restaurant management or sales experience within the food and beverage industry.

- Strong ability to leverage data and analytics to inform strategic decision-making and build compelling business cases.

- Exceptional time management, discovery, and negotiation skills.

- A highly collaborative, team-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous learning and
hospitality technology.

Benefits and Perks 

- Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday:

- 25 days of paid vacation

- Additional paid time off for key life moments, including your wedding and moving day

- Paid volunteer time

- Paid parental leave

- Pension plan contributions

- Supplemental accident insurance

- Health insurance subsidy of 250 CHF per month

- Lunch-Check Card of 180 CHF per month

- Access to Swibeco discounts and perks

- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

- Focus on mental health and well-being:

- Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

- Company-paid subscription to Headspace

- Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

- Focus on your career growth:

- Development Dollars

- Leadership development

- Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

- Travel Discounts

- Employee Resource Groups

Work Environment & Flexibility 

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

title: Product Engineer
description:
The Context 

Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do.

Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows.

We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath.

The Mission 

You'll own features in their entirety. Self-standing or with guidance of founders and fellow engineers, you turn a clear problem statement into a strong design and build, test, and ship new features that directly enable our customers. You integrate features across our layered stack, from the API to the data plane, and carry them all the way to production.

This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin.

Your responsibilities 

- Ship features end-to-end: Deliver complete vertical slices across the stack, from the API layer to the data model, carried through to running in production.

- Grow what the platform does for banks: Build the services Porters performs for banks: Extend the capabilities of our agentic platform such as case handling, customer matching, AI tool integrations, data enrichment, or keeping humans in the loop.

- Deliver features that hold together as a system: Design endpoints, contracts, and interfaces that work together, ensuring features integrate cleanly towards one bigger outcome.

- Ensure your work is reliable: Own design, development, tests, and deployment, so what reaches production is proven to work.

- Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters, made my day”.

Your profile 

- Experience: Around 4 years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

- Product thinking: You naturally understand why you’re building something, not just focusing on how to build.

- Quality focus & individual problem solving: Given a clear problem, you reliably produce a clean algorithm, a sensible data model, a well-structured service. You treat tests and observability as part of the feature, and right-size rigor to risk. You are comfortable in a regulated fintech environment where precision matters.

- Technical proficiency: Proficiency in Python is mandatory, along with REST API development, an ORM, and relational databases.

- AI-native: You've worked with, or are eager to work with, LLM/agentic tooling, and understand how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code.

- Collaboration and eagerness to learn: You thrive on direction, review, and challenge, take feedback well, and want to grow into larger scopes. You are eager to learn every day.

- Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people.

What We Offer 

- Ownership from day one: Real features running in production at major financial institutions, with the trust to carry them there yourself.

- Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before.

- We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time.

- Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.

Our stack 

- Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

- Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

- AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

- Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

- Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts.

- Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench.

- Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

- Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
- Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
- Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
- Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 
AI Governance and Inventory 

- Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
- Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
- Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 
Data Engineering and Platform 

- Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
- Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables. 
- Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

Requirements 

- 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
- Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
- Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
- Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
- Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). 
- Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design). 
- Cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery. 
- Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. 
- Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). 
- Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). 
Equally important is how you think: 

- You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. 
- You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. 
- You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. 
- You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. 
Nice to have: 

- Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. 
What we are not looking for: 

- "Prompt engineers" with no production experience. 
- Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. 
- Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. 
Benefits 

- Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals
- Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
- Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies
- Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth
- Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
- Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
- Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture 

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

- Innovation and Continuous Learning
- Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
- Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies
- Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

Please note: 

- We do not accept CVs from recruiting or staffing agencies.
- Due to the Swiss/German labor legislation, we can only accept applicants who have the right to work in Switzerland or Germany (are in possession of a Swiss/German work permit or are EU/EFTA citizens). All other applications will not be considered.
- If this is the position for you, and you have a Swiss/German work permit and/or EU citizenship, please send us your complete application, incl. cover letter, CV, and references.

title: Outside Account Manager - Switzerland
description:
For more than 50 years, Cannondale has been a leading innovator in the cycling world. As more riders of all ages and abilities get on the roads, trails, and streets than ever before, we're here to do the best work of our lives to push the greatest human-powered machine into the future each and every day. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce where every teammate can succeed as we inspire riders everywhere. Fueled by a free-thinking, always-game, got-your-back mentality, we ditched the rulebook and set forward on a path to make iconic bikes that simply work better. We look forward to the ride with you. 

As our Outside Account Manager for Western Switzerland, you'll be the face of Cannondale to our dealer network, building strong partnerships that fuel growth and elevate the rider experience. You’ll take the lead in managing and growing relationships with both current and future authorized dealers, owning the territory’s business plan and driving it to hit ambitious sales targets. You’re not just selling bikes, you’re shaping how Cannondale shows up in the market. With a sharp eye for opportunity and a deep understanding of the cycling industry, you’ll ensure every partner feels connected, supported, and set up to succeed with Cannondale.

How You'll Make an Impact: 

- Work closely with Inside Sales, After Sales, Credit, and other internal teams to strengthen dealer relationships and hit sales goals

- Bring Cannondale’s commercial strategy to life, building a future-ready retail network that’s strong, agile, and aligned

- Drive active sales and deliver top-tier service to dealers across your territory

- Support dealers with marketing tools and guidance to help grow their business

- Lead distribution efforts and play a key role in territory growth

- Support accounts receivable efforts and ensure timely collections

- Take part in sales trainings, seminars, and ongoing education

- Share valuable market insights and product feedback with the Product team

- Represent Cannondale at dealer events, national trade shows, and local demos

- Follow company policies and contribute to process improvement and operational excellence

- Team up with colleagues across our Europe region, sharing ideas, feedback, and best practices

- Champion and encourage a positive working environment and effective teamwork in line with the Company’s values, behaviors and culture 

- Step up to lead or support other projects as needed to drive company success

What You Bring to the Table: 

- An Education in Sales or a Bachelor’s degree in the field of economics, international business, sales management or a similar field 

- An extensive network within the territory to manage and within the cycling, sports or outdoor industry 

- Experience in a similar position within cycling, sports or outdoor industry 

- Excellent team-player attitude, with strong motivation, drive and communication capabilities 

- Absolutely convinced of the importance of results and timelines 

- Willing to travel frequently and work in a remote capacity 

- Excellent fit with Cannondale sales culture, which means entrepreneurial, dynamic, highly motivated individual with can-do mentality 

- Experience with B2B relationships and C ommercial & Sales success 

- Fluent in both French, German, and English (written & verbal) 

- A valid Driver’s license 

- Prior experience working for a global brand and multi-national business 

- A passion for mountain bikes, road bikes and Ebikes , actions sports, and/or outdoor lifestyle 

Some of our Great Benefits:  

- An inspiring position within an international working environment around a sustainable, future-proof mobility product, the bicycle 

- A dynamic, international and challenging role with various internal and external stakeholders 

- Various growth opportunities within Pon.Bike 

- Hybrid work environment 

- A mix of casual yet professional culture 

Want a closer look into what it's like to Come Ride With Us? Explore more of Cannondale on  Instagram  and  LinkedIn . 

About the organization 

As a proud member of the Pon Holdings family, Cannondale benefits from the strong foundation and extensive network of one of the Netherlands' largest family-owned businesses, as well as the largest bike portfolio in the world: Pon.Bike, including brands like Gazelle, Santa Cruz, Cervélo, Kalkhoff, Focus, Urban Arrow, Veloretti and Swapfiets. Being a part of Cannondale means being part of a dynamic and forward-thinking organization backed by the strength and stability of Pon Holdings. 

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Cannondale we value a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, regardless of your gender or race, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Our DEI Mission Statement: At Cannondale, we are on a mission to ensure all members of the cycling community feel that they belong. Our commitment to celebrating individuality and differences extends beyond our diverse line up of bikes to our workplace culture, where we recognize and embrace the strengths and viewpoints of each team member, regardless of their background or identity. We are thankful for the feedback and perspectives that challenge us to create more inclusivity in this space and hold us accountable to making meaningful progress.

description:

What to know: 

- Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.

- We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.

- Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at 

About Commvault 

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. 

Account Executive is responsible for achieving quota by selling solutions into a defined account list that may include current Commvault customers and high value prospects. The position is a field sales role where the AE will engage in face-to-face sales with customers and prospects either directly or through partners. The Account Executive plans, organizes, leads and controls balanced sales growth, account penetration and customer satisfaction on a long-term multi-quarter basis. This individual may lead a cross-functional sales team and is responsible for creating sales campaigns to penetrate/expand his/her target accounts. The AE must have the ability to articulate an in-depth understanding of the customers’ environment, current challenges/goals and have the ability to align Commvault solutions to those challenges/goals including a financial and strategic value proposition. The candidate must have a history of success in selling complex software platforms (vs. IT component or narrow focused tools) and should have some level of prior engagement with the target account set.

How you will make an impact: 

- Achieve quarterly and annual quotas by selling to new and established - large, complex prospects and customer.

- Develop and implement Strategic account plans for target account expansion and new account acquisition including performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.

- Create sale campaigns into target accounts and closely coordinate company executive involvement with customer/prospect leadership.

- Coordinate the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources, in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.

- Manage a matrixed sales team; liaison with clients, Deal Desk, inside sales, partners, channels, sales engineers, professional services, finance and legal to drive a prospect to close

- Establish and maintain a productive, professional relationship with key personnel in assigned customer/prospect accounts.

- Construct and deliver tangible business cases at the CXO level including financial (ROI & TCO), technical and strategic value propositions

- Prepare and present sales proposals and presentations to new and existing clients

- Identify and build strategic relationships with partners and alliances that have existing relationships with the assigned target accounts

- Negotiate and close deals following the company’s practices and processes

- Ensure orders meet all legal and financial requirements

- Maintain a high level of relevant industry, Commvault and competitive knowledge

- Plan, attend and coordinate executive briefings

- Leverage internal sales tools and processes to drive opportunities to a successful close.

Position Requirements include: 

- Experience in identifying, building relationships and selling directly or with partners

- Excellent communication skills, persuasive, listening skills

- Background in IT infrastructure, security and SAAS

- Experience of MEDDICC sales methodology or similar would be an advantage

- Fluent German language skills

- Experience selling software solutions
