title: HR & EOR Operations Manager
description:
Part-Time | Switzerland (Remote) | Global EOR & HR Platform | Employed via Swiss Entity 

ABOUT THE CLIENT 

Our client is a fast-growing global HR, payroll, and compliance platform operating across 180+ regions. The company combines technology with owned entities, in-house legal and payroll expertise, transparent pricing, and dedicated human support - helping businesses of all sizes hire talent anywhere in the world.

The company is driven by a constant pursuit of innovation, expanding its product suite to create integrated HR solutions for businesses from fledgling startups to global enterprises.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for an HR & EOR Operations Manager to join our Swiss entity on a part-time basis. This is a hands-on operational role - not a purely administrative or advisory position.

As part of the role, you will serve as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under SECO/Zürich personnel leasing law, fulfilling a standing legal obligation tied to our EOR licence. This means you must be genuinely employed, operationally involved, and present in Switzerland - not an external adviser lending a name to a form.

Day-to-day workload is manageable within a 50% FTE, and you will be fully supported by the company's global HR, payroll and compliance teams. Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome, provided they do not interfere with your availability and supervision of the entity's activities.

This role is a strong fit for HR or EOR professionals already freelancing, holding consulting mandates, or looking to add a substantive part-time role to their portfolio.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Act as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under Swiss personnel leasing (SECO) law.

- Ensure compliance with Swiss labour-leasing legislation, Swiss employment law, and the staffing industry GAV (minimum wages and equal treatment).

- Maintain documentation required for SECO and cantonal audits and inspections.

- Serve as the primary Swiss contact for SECO and cantonal authorities.

- Oversee HR and employment operations for the Swiss entity - including onboarding, contract controls, and employment matters.

- Support payroll oversight in collaboration with the global payroll team.

- Handle employee and client escalations related to HR and compliance matters.

- Supervise the entity's EOR/personnel leasing activities and ensure they are conducted properly.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

Right to Work in Switzerland - one of the following is required:

- Swiss citizen.

- EU/EFTA national with a current Swiss B or C permit.

- Non-EU/EFTA national with a Swiss C permit (a non-EU/EFTA B permit alone does not qualify).

- EU/EFTA national with a genuine 5-year cross-border G permit.

Education: 

Any completed qualification - EFZ apprenticeship, Matura/Abitur, or university degree in any field.

Experience - either route qualifies: 

Standard route: 

3+ years in one of the following: recruitment or placement, personnel leasing or staffing (including EOR), substantive HR (not admin-only), personnel consulting, or organisational/business consulting. Employment certificates confirming dates, workload percentage and substantive duties are required alongside a CV.

Alternative route: 

3+ years of general professional experience plus a completed, recognised HR qualification with a passed exam (e.g. HRSE or VSH HR Assistant). Course attendance without a final certificate does not count.

Character: 

Clean criminal record, debt-enforcement register and tax history.

Other: 

- Comfortable being named on the Commercial Register with signing authority.

- Willing to disclose other jobs, board mandates or licensed-business responsibilities.

- Genuinely hands-on - purely advisory profiles (external lawyers or accountants with no operational involvement) are not suitable.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT 

This is a rare opportunity for an experienced HR or EOR professional in Switzerland to take on a meaningful operational role at a global scale without committing to a full-time position.

You will hold a real and recognised legal position within the Swiss entity, with direct contact with SECO and cantonal authorities, while being backed by an experienced international HR, payroll and compliance team.

The 50% structure makes this accessible to consultants, freelancers and professionals looking to add a substantive part-time engagement alongside existing work. International EOR or HR experience is fully valid - experience does not need to be Swiss-based, though familiarity with Swiss employment law and social insurance is an advantage.

The company values a builder mentality - people who want to improve processes, not just maintain them.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT 

- Fully remote within Switzerland.

- Part-time 50% FTE with flexible hours.

- Direct collaboration with the global HR, payroll and compliance teams.

- Meaningful presence in Switzerland required (~50% benchmark) - remote-only offshore oversight does not meet regulatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER 

- Health insurance contributions.

- Share incentives.

- Learning and mentorship opportunities.

- Team offsites and social events.

- 4 weeks of work-from-anywhere per year.

- Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer - Zero Trust
description:
About cogify group

cogify was founded in Switzerland in 2018 and today combines expertise in consulting, AI, software engineering, cybersecurity and digital products.

We are expanding our cybersecurity capabilities and are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer with a strong interest in Zero Trust who understands how modern IT environments work and can turn security requirements into reliable technical solutions.

Your Mission

As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you work at the interface between security, infrastructure, cloud and delivery .

You understand how identities, devices, applications and networks interact, identify security weaknesses and implement controls that reduce risk without unnecessarily slowing down the business.

You work closely with our cybersecurity architects and engineering teams – from technical design and technology evaluation through configuration, integration, testing and production.

Requirements 

Your Responsibilities

- Implement and integrate Zero Trust security solutions
- Configure and improve IAM, MFA, SSO, conditional access and least-privilege controls
- Implement ZTNA, SASE, network segmentation and secure connectivity
- Secure cloud, hybrid and on-premise environments
- Implement endpoint, network, identity and workload security controls
- Integrate identity providers, applications and security platforms
- Configure, test and optimise security technologies
- Analyse security issues and support remediation and troubleshooting
- Improve security monitoring, logging and detection capabilities
- Automate security configurations and controls where it creates value
- Document technical solutions, configurations and security controls
- Work closely with cybersecurity architects, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps and software teams
- Support customer projects from technical design through implementation
Your Profile

- Experience in cybersecurity engineering, network security, cloud security, infrastructure security or a comparable technical role 
- Good understanding of Zero Trust principles and modern cybersecurity technologies 
- Hands-on experience in one or more areas such as IAM, ZTNA, SASE, network security, segmentation, cloud security, endpoint security or access control 
- Good understanding of enterprise networks, identity, authentication and cloud environments
- Experience implementing, integrating, configuring or operating security technologies
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
- Ability to understand technical requirements and turn them into reliable implementations
- Hands-on mindset and curiosity for new security technologies
- Independent and quality-focused way of working
- Fluent English or German is required 
Nice to Have

- Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Sentinel, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike or similar technologies
- Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud
- Experience with PowerShell, Python, Terraform, Ansible or Infrastructure-as-Code
- Knowledge of NIST, CIS, ISO 27001 or Zero Trust frameworks
- Relevant cybersecurity certifications
- German, French or other languages in addition to your primary working language
Benefits 

Why cogify?

At cogify, cybersecurity is closely connected to engineering.

You work on real environments and help turn security architecture into solutions that run in production.

You will work alongside cybersecurity architects as well as our cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, software and AI teams, giving you the opportunity to deepen your expertise across different technologies and customer environments.

We offer a competitive salary , a flexible working environment, modern technologies and the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.

We are looking for people who understand technology, enjoy solving difficult problems and want to build security that works in practice.

Sound like you? We look forward to meeting you.

What is The Role 

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to be the primary product voice for Elastic Security's most strategic enterprise customers. Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems. They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas. 

In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security's product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once. You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle. You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship. You will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering, building the structure that lets Elastic scale close customer relationships without simply adding headcount. 

What You Will Be Doing 

- 
Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in “under consideration.” 

- 
Translate customer requirements into shipped products. Work at the level of customer pain, not just the feature that was asked for, and synthesize input from many accounts into a single, coherent product direction. 

- 
Turn input from strategic accounts into successful products. Look for patterns across accounts. Shape some of these patterns into formal partnerships for design. Make sure the resulting capabilities benefit the wider market, not just the single customer that made the request. 

- 
Feed validated customer patterns back into the core product roadmaps, influencing direction well beyond the accounts you cover. 

- 
Serve as the primary product voice in meetings with senior customer stakeholders, including the CISO, CTO, and VP of Security Operations. Deliver roadmap updates, including deprioritizations and misses, in a way that keeps the relationship deep. 

- 
Prioritize customer-sourced requirements using structured frameworks such as RICE, weighted scoring, and opportunity sizing. Use data where it is available and clear judgment where it is thin, and be transparent about which is which. 

- 
Partner with product and engineering leads to write requirements they can act on without follow-up clarification meetings. Understand system architecture well enough to assess feasibility and scope on your own. 

- 
Operate across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Legal. Support deal cycles as a product resource through RFP responses, security questionnaires, and roadmap presentations to prospects. 

- 
Navigate tension between a customer's contractual expectations and the internal roadmap , and tackle it directly rather than through routine escalation. 

- 
Create artifacts such as roadmap trackers, enhancement request dashboards, and decision memos that give customers and internal stakeholders visibility without requiring a meeting. 

- 
Advocate for customer needs inside the company while resisting the pull of the loudest or largest customer setting the roadmap at the expense of the broader market. 

What You Bring 

- 
Extensive Experience: 7–10 years of product management experience, with at least 4 years in B2B enterprise software. A consistent record of owning a product area with meaningful revenue impact and of leading products from customer input through shipped, iterated outcomes. Direct experience working with named strategic accounts, not only through customer success proxies. Experience with hyperscalers, MSSPs and/or PubSec is a solid plus. 

- 
Security Domain Knowledge: Hands-on knowledge with SIEM, SOAR, XDR or broader security operations platforms, either as a product manager or as a practitioner such as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect. You can credibly discuss detection engineering, log ingestion pipelines, correlation rules, threat hunting workflows, and compliance use cases without a solutions engineer in the room. You understand the difference between what a CISO wants to hear and what a SOC analyst actually needs. A background as a security practitioner, such as SOC, incident response, or detection engineering, before moving into product is a solid plus, and brings credibility that is hard to teach. 

- 
Enhancement Request Management at Scale: You have personally run a structured enhancement request pipeline across several enterprise accounts at the same time. You can step into a relationship with dozens of open requests and no prior documentation and build a working tracking system within weeks. 

- 
Executive Presence: You are comfortable as the primary product voice with C-suite and VP-level customer stakeholders. You can deliver difficult news without losing the relationship, and you can hold both the executive view and the analyst view in the same meeting. 

- 
Technical Credibility: You earn respect from engineering through the quality of your requirements rather than through authority. You write specs engineers can act on, and you know enough about architecture to judge feasibility and scope. 

- 
Cross-functional Leadership and Influence: You have operated at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Legal, and you know which function owns what and how to advance work across all of them. You lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a dynamic, remote-first environment, with the autonomy and judgment expected of a principal-level product leader. 

- 
Structured Thinking and Bias for Closure: You bring order to unstructured problems, using data to prioritize and clear judgment when data is thin, and staying transparent about which is which. You move work through the system and follow up proactively rather than waiting to be asked, defaulting to visibility through artifacts instead of meetings. You advocate for customer needs while synthesizing them into product direction rather than relaying demands. 

- 
Comfortable with AI-Augmented Work: You use AI tooling for synthesis, documentation, and preparation as a regular part of your workflow, which lets you manage a higher volume of customer context than a pre-AI workflow would allow. You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes. You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities. You can work autonomously, drive decisions and result in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Communication Excellence: You have impressive spoken and written communication skills. You can distill complex detection engineering and security operations concepts into clear narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive management.

- Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

- Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.

Dein Profil Technisch 

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

- Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

Persönlich

- Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

- Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

- KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.

Warum wir? Code. Chill. Repeat.

Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.

title: Account Specialist - Berlin
description:
About Us: 

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role: 

We’re looking for a true startup Operations person. Good onboarding is what makes our merchants set up for success. From the first meeting, the go-live to working and growing together - this person will own the onboarding process and make it all happen. This role is for someone who likes working with the product, becoming an expert in it and teaching others. 

Your day-to-day will be a mix of hands-on ops, project management, customer communication and problem solving. We are reshaping the future of hospitality tech, and this role is at the forefront of it.

What You’ll Do: 

Our Operations happen on a restaurant floor, in a lively neighbourhood, at a busy bar - we operate in the city:

- Run restaurant onboarding: train, connect and implement together with the restaurant team

- Problem-solve for our merchants on the ground while running live operations

- Support restaurants for the first month after the go live

- Find opportunities for improvement in our process, materials and systems

- Identify product and process gaps and bring it to internal central teams such as product, engineering and central operations

What You’ll Need: 

- You are a creative problem solver who enjoys interacting with hospitality businesses

- You are empathetic towards our merchants and curious about their business

- You can juggle multiple things at once and bring structure

- Curious about the product, want to be an expert in Tebi system and can apply your knowledge

- Good communication - you are great at proactive contact and managing expectations

- Being comfortable with high-pace environments: both the hospitality flow and the startup day-to-day

- Flexibility in working hours to fit our merchants’ needs

- At least 1-2 years of experience in hospitality, early startup operations, fast-paced account management or customer operations

- You are comfortable working in both German and English

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/de /careers .

Benefits: 

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Flexible Time-off

- Team events

What is Restaurant Software? 

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi 

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Lead Product Engineer (a)
description:
Über uns MEONDI ist Unternehmenspartner für Digitalisierung und neue Arbeitsstrukturen. Wir navigieren unsere Kunden ganzheitlich durch Innovations- und Transformationsprozesse sowie agile Produktentwicklungen.
Mit MEONDI Frontier Services beschäftigen wir uns gezielt mit neuen Technologien und den Möglichkeiten, die daraus für Unternehmen entstehen. Wir beraten unsere Kunden dabei nicht nur, sondern entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihnen neue Konzepte, validieren diese früh und setzen daraus konkrete digitale Produkte und Lösungen um.
Unser Anspruch ist es, neue technologische Möglichkeiten früh zu verstehen, sinnvoll auf reale Probleme zu übertragen und daraus Lösungen zu entwickeln, die tatsächlich im Alltag funktionieren.
Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung dafür übernehmen, dass aus einer Produktidee ein belastbares Softwareprodukt wird?
Als Lead Product Engineer bist du ein zentraler Teil von MEONDI Frontier Services und gestaltest mit uns, wie wir neue Produkte technisch denken und umsetzen. Du bringst die technische Perspektive von Anfang an in wichtige Entscheidungen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Konsequenzen dieser Entscheidungen.
Dabei arbeitest du nicht in einer fertig definierten Rolle mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben. Du gestaltest die technische Seite unseres Produktgeschäfts aktiv mit, setzt Standards, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und baust selbst mit. Wenn wir mit unseren Produkten erfolgreich skalieren, wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich mit.
Du verbindest fundiertes Software Engineering mit einem praktischen Verständnis für AI-Produkte und agentische Systeme. Du weißt, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt werden kann, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen, skalierbaren und wirtschaftlich tragfähigen Produkten zusammenkommt.

Zusätzliche Reisebereitschaft ist erforderlich und richtet sich nach dem jeweiligen Kundenprojekt. Je nach Projekt arbeitest du regelmäßig und möglicherweise mehrere Tage pro Woche vor Ort beim Kunden. Remote-Arbeit ist grundsätzlich möglich, sofern die jeweiligen Projekt- und Kundenanforderungen dies zulassen. Darüber hinaus solltest du bereit sein, regelmäßig bei MEONDI, insbesondere im Raum Stuttgart, präsent zu sein und an internen MEONDI-Events sowie Community-Treffen teilzunehmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt:

Lead Product Engineer (a) 

Deine Aufgaben - Technische Machbarkeit bewerten: Opportunities früh hinsichtlich Architektur, Risiken, Aufwand und Umsetzbarkeit einschätzen.
- Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Produktspezifikationen in tragfähige technische Lösungen übersetzen und zentrale Architekturentscheidungen treffen.
- Hands-on Software entwickeln: Produktive Software selbst bauen – vom Frontend über Backend und Datenhaltung bis zu Schnittstellen und Betrieb.
- Produktionsreife sicherstellen: Stabilität, Skalierbarkeit, Security, DevOps, Observability, Wartbarkeit und Betrieb von Anfang an berücksichtigen.
- Prototypen in Produkte überführen: Schnelle Validierungen technisch einordnen und daraus belastbare, langfristig tragfähige Systeme entwickeln.
- AI-native Softwaresysteme entwickeln: Verstehen, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt wird, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen Produkten zusammenkommt.
- AI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung weiterentwickeln: Moderne Coding Agents und neue Engineering-Ansätze praktisch einsetzen, kritisch bewerten und sinnvoll in die Entwicklungsarbeit integrieren.
- Engineering-Standards prägen: Architekturprinzipien, Tooling, Entwicklungsprozesse und Qualitätsstandards für Frontier Services mit aufbauen.

Das bringst du mit - Du hast einen belastbaren Track Record mit produktiv eingesetzter Software .
- Du hast bereits Verantwortung für Software übernommen und kennst die Anforderungen, die daraus im echten Betrieb entstehen.
- Du hast Erfahrung in einem Produktumfeld oder einer vergleichbaren Situation mit echtem Skin in the Game für Qualität, Nutzen und Betrieb der Software.
- Du kannst offene und unvollständig definierte Probleme selbstständig strukturieren , Lösungswege entwickeln und die richtigen nächsten Schritte bestimmen.
- Du kannst dich nicht hinter großen Teams oder eng geschnittenen Tickets verstecken, sondern übernimmst Ownership für das Ergebnis .
- Du besitzt ein starkes Full-Stack-Verständnis und kannst vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig entwickeln.
- Du beherrschst die Grundlagen moderner Softwareentwicklung sicher – von Datenbanken, APIs und Architektur bis zu Testing, Cloud, Deployment, Security und Betrieb .
- Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs, AI-Agenten und AI-basierten Anwendungen und verstehst, wie diese mit klassischer Softwarelogik zusammenspielen.
- Du nutzt Coding Agents und AI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge produktiv und kannst deren Möglichkeiten und Grenzen realistisch einschätzen.
- Du verbindest hohe Qualitätsansprüche mit Pragmatismus . Du vermeidest sowohl Overengineering als auch kurzfristige Lösungen, deren Konsequenzen später andere tragen müssen.
- Du arbeitest gerne hands-on und validierst technische Entscheidungen im Code und in realen Systemen .
- Englisch: sehr gute, verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse.
- Deutsch: ein klarer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Kein bestimmter Abschluss erforderlich. Entscheidend sind technisches Urteilsvermögen, praktische Erfahrung und die Fähigkeit, produktive Software ganzheitlich zu entwickeln. Ein technisches Studium kann hilfreich sein, ist aber keine Voraussetzung.

Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unseres zukünftigen Produktgeschäfts. Du erhältst großen Einfluss auf Architektur, Toolchain, Engineering-Prinzipien und technische Ausrichtung.

Bei MEONDI erwartet dich eine Kultur, die von Offenheit, Transparenz und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe geprägt ist. Wir glauben an unternehmerisches Denken, Eigenverantwortung und daran, dass nachhaltige Lösungen im echten Dialog entstehen.

Mobile Working ist bei uns gelebte Realität. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub ermöglichen dir, Beruf und Leben in Einklang zu bringen – remote, in einem unserer Hubs oder beim Kunden.

Du gestaltest eine Rolle mit, die mit unserem Produktgeschäft wachsen soll. Bei erfolgreichem Product-Market-Fit besteht die Perspektive, die technische Leitung des Bereichs zu übernehmen und ein Engineering-Team aufzubauen.

title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
description:
Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries. Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a

Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) 
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 

You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.

Your responsibilities include - Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
- Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
- Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
- Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks. 
- Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
- Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
- Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
- Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
- Actively contributing to internal discussions.
- Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
- As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
- As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.

We are looking for - A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
- As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
- As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass
- A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. 
- Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors.
- Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. 
- Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus.
- Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. 
- Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus.
- Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers.
- A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact.
- Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents.
- Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus.
- Willingness to travel outside Europe.

It offers biotech, pharmaceutical and medical device companies solutions for market access, pricing and reimbursement of their medical innovations. To strengthen our team in the area of Value Strategy & RWE , we are looking for a Senior Consultant Real World Evidence - Focus on Healthcare Data Analysis (m/f/d) 

Your mission - Design, execution, evaluation and interpretation of analyses based on claims data – in particular health insurance fund data (GKV) and/or registry data – from data preparation through cohort definition to the presentation of results

- Programming skills in R or Python would be an advantage
- Knowledge of HTA/market access requirements is welcome but not essential

- Open-minded and communicative personality with a team- and client-oriented approach
- Fluent written and spoken German and English (academic level)

- Flexible working arrangements after structured training at the Berlin site, including the option to work from home

title: Short-Form Video & Content Creator (m/f/d)
description:
GetMOW is one of the companies being built at Cloud Studios, a product studio in Berlin.

This role sits across the wider Cloud Studios ecosystem, not just GetMOW. Your main focus will be creating content around Cloud Studios, our team, our products and the reality of building companies from scratch.

We’re not looking for someone to sit behind a laptop all day editing corporate videos.

We’re looking for someone who walks into the office with a camera and sees content everywhere. A weird conversation becomes a video. A team moment becomes a recurring series. Something happens while building a company and you turn it into a story people actually want to watch.

Think Kinso, HeyClicky, Cluely or SULT rather than traditional B2B marketing.

Tasks

- Own short-form video content across Cloud Studios and its products, primarily for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn.

- Be in the office regularly, capturing what is actually happening rather than manufacturing everything from behind a desk.

- Turn everyday startup moments, conversations, failures, wins and chaos into entertaining content.

- Develop recurring formats, characters, series, office skits, interviews and social-first concepts.

- Write hooks, scripts and storylines that make people stop scrolling.

- Film and edit content from idea to finished post.

- Be comfortable getting in front of the camera yourself when the concept calls for it.

- Experiment constantly with formats, trends, storytelling styles and ideas.

- Help build Cloud Studios into a brand people want to follow, not just a company they know exists.

- Spend roughly 5 hours per week creating content specifically for GetMOW, turning topics like AI visibility, organic growth, experiments and the journey of building GetMOW into engaging content.

- Work closely with the founders and wider team, while having significant creative ownership yourself.

The goal is simple: make content people would watch even if they had no idea what Cloud Studios or GetMOW was 

Requirements

Important: This position is a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum). You must be required to complete an internship as part of your university, school or educational programme and be able to provide confirmation of this. 

Beyond that, we care much more about your taste, creativity and energy than your CV.

You’re probably a good fit if:

- You genuinely understand short-form content and internet culture.

- You naturally think in hooks, stories, formats and “this could be a video” moments.

- You have strong creative taste and can tell when something feels boring, forced or too corporate.

- You can film and edit short-form video confidently.

title: Software Engineer (gn) @ Stealth AI Venture, Berlin
description:
What we're building 

Factories run on machines that generate huge amounts of data, and almost none of it gets used. We're changing that. We build AI software that turns machine and operational data into knowledge people can act on: for troubleshooting, for decisions, and for automation.

We're early and in stealth. Our two founders both held C-level roles at leading German robotics ventures. They have spent years bringing advanced technology onto real shop floors, and now they're hiring the founding team.

The role 

You'll build the software that makes sense of what happens on a manufacturing floor. That includes sensor measurements, actuator states, quality measurements, and operational events, streamed from connected machines and autonomous systems. Our platform processes this data to power analysis and automated workflows.

We work AI-first. Our coding agents know our platform and our engineering practices, and you'll use them every day. You're still the engineer, though. You'll review every line, understand what it does, and test it properly. That frees you to focus on the application, the industrial domain, and the quality of the system.

We care about what you can show, how fast you learn, and whether you take ownership. Seniority and years of experience matter less.

What you'll do 

- Own features end to end: understand the problem, choose the approach, then build, test, ship, and follow up

- Get to know the existing codebase in depth, including its architecture, dependencies, data flows, and failure modes

- Write code with AI tools and review each change line by line for correctness, maintainability, security, and impact on the wider system

- Build meaningful unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and wire them into CI

- Test against messy real-world data, using recorded streams, representative datasets, and simulated devices. Cover missing or delayed measurements, duplicate or out-of-order events, invalid values, and dropped connections

- Reproduce failures, fix them, and add regression tests so they don't return. Make sure tests reflect the intended behavior, and challenge the assumptions in the implementation

- Build and improve backend services, APIs, and data pipelines for industrial analytics, knowledge retrieval, and automated workflows

- Learn how our users and their factories work, so you can spot the right improvements and make good engineering calls

- Help wherever it's needed: integration, deployment, documentation, and technical investigation. Flag progress, capacity, trade-offs, and blockers early

You might be a fit if you 

- Write strong, practical Python and understand the advanced features and patterns used in production code

- Have built and maintained substantial software: finding your way in an existing codebase, debugging behavior you've never seen before, and shipping reliable changes

- Think like a tester: you turn requirements into test cases, set sensible test boundaries, build useful test data, and dig into failures

- Have solid fundamentals in software design, APIs, data handling, testing, debugging, and version control

- Can explain what code does, why it works, where it could break, and how to verify it, including code an AI helped write

- Like AI coding tools, use them a lot, and stay critical of their output, because you own the result

- Break down unfamiliar problems, investigate on your own, and ask sharp questions when you need to

- Find the next useful step yourself and keep moving without being told what to do

- Are comfortable with shifting priorities, varying workloads, and a broad scope, and communicate and prioritize clearly

- Write and speak clear English

A degree is optional. We care about evidence that you can engineer, not about a title or a specific path.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Lead (all genders)
description:
Your Mission EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 
- Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform. 
- Agree on definitions , data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them. 
- Maintain and verify the certified data layer , built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it. 
- Use SQL to validate data , investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources. 
- Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning. 
- Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree. 
- Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation. 
- Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully. 

What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 

What you bring along Must-have 
- Senior experience in BI , analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful. 
- Strong SQL skills .You can read and write SQL ,validate data, and trace where a number comes from. 
- Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners. 
- Experience with data models , data quality , or data governance. 
- A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations. 
- Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers. 
- A hands-on , business-minded approach . You connect business questions with practical data solutions. 
- Experience with automation , AI Agents , or AI-supported workflows . 
- Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus. 
Nice to have 
- Experience with Metabase , dbt , AWS Glue , Spark , Airbyte , or comparable tools. 
- Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes. 
- Experience in B2B SaaS , EV charging , energy , mobility, or a related field. 
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL , sound data thinking , and the ability to bring people to one shared definition .

What you can expect from us How we work 
Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable.

Where you will work 
Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week. 

What you get 
- 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest. 
- Mental health , taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive. 
- AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down. 
- Move sustainably - JobRad , subsidised public transport , or EGYM Wellpass . You choose what fits your life. 
- €1,000 learning budget -Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow. 
- Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO . Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fineprint.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Meta Ads & Full-Funnel Growth - 100% remote
description:
Wir sind eine stark wachsende Direct-to-Consumer-Marke im Gesundheitsbereich und verkaufen hochwertige Supplements direkt an unsere Kund:innen. Unsere wichtigste Wachstumsmaschine: Direct-Response-Marketing über Meta Ads.

Ein hoher ROAS ist für uns kein Ziel – meistens ist er ein Zeichen dafür, dass zu wenig ausgegeben wird. Wir steuern auf Wachstum: Neukunden, CM3, aMER, MER und ein CAC, der sich am Kundenwert misst. Wenn du ohnehin in Deckungsbeiträgen und CAC/CLV denkst statt in Plattformkennzahlen, ist das hier dein Standard. Wenn nicht, ist es die falsche Stelle.

Wir suchen jemanden, der den kompletten Funnel von der Ad über das Offer und die Landingpage bis zum Kauf als ein System versteht, systematisch testet und Budget dorthin bringt, wo es profitables Wachstum erzeugt – auch wenn das auf Plattformebene erstmal unbequem aussieht.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben 

- Media Buying auf Wachstum steuern: Du verantwortest unsere Paid-Social-Konten eigenständig – Budget, Kampagnensetup, Adsets, Creatives einbuchen. Du skalierst, solange die Unit Economics tragen, und skalierst nicht, um Plattformmetriken zu schonen.

- Full-Funnel-Diagnose: Du analysierst regelmäßig den gesamten Weg von Ad über Offer und Landingpage bis zur Conversion, findest den größten Engpass und priorisierst genau dort.

- Creative Testing & Creative Diversity: Du entwickelst Testhypothesen, bewertest Creative-Performance und sorgst dafür, dass das Konto nicht von zwei Winning Ads abhängt: verschiedene Angles, Formate, Creator und Hooks parallel im Test, damit Skalierung nicht an Creative Fatigue scheitert. Learnings gehen konkret und datenbasiert an Creative Strategist und Copywriting zurück.

- Offer- und Landingpage-Tests koordinieren: Du priorisierst den Test-Backlog für Bundles, Preislogik, Value Stack, Message-Match und Landingpage-Struktur, briefst die Fachteams, wertest aus und rollst Gewinner aus.

- Steuerung nach Gesamtwirtschaftlichkeit: Deine Entscheidungsgrundlage sind Neukunden, CM3, aMER, MER und CAC im Verhältnis zum Kundenwert – nicht der ROAS einer einzelnen Kampagne.

- Attribution & Datenqualität: Du liest Performance nicht aus dem Ads Manager, sondern aus unserem Attributionsmodell. Du weißt, wo Plattform-Attribution und Realität auseinanderlaufen, sorgst für saubere Datenerfassung und klärst Auffälligkeiten früh mit IT.

- Struktur & Reporting: Einheitliche Naming Convention, nachvollziehbare Account-Struktur, feste Reporting- und Review-Routinen für Wachstum, Budget und Learnings.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil 

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Media Buying für Meta Ads im D2C-Kontext – du hast eigenverantwortlich Budgets gesteuert und ein Konto profitabel wachsen lassen , nicht nur effizient gehalten.

- Du kannst erklären, warum ein Konto mit ROAS 1,0 und wachsendem Neukundenstamm mehr wert ist als eines mit ROAS 4 und stagnierendem Umsatz – und du hast das schon einmal jemandem erklären müssen.

- Du denkst in Funnels und Kohorten: Du weißt, dass ein schlechter Neukunden-CAC auch am Offer oder an der Landingpage liegen kann, und dass der Wert eines Neukunden erst nach dem ersten Kauf entsteht.

- Testgetrieben: Du setzt Tests mit klarer Hypothese, Erfolgskriterium und Auswertungslogik auf und dokumentierst, was du lernst.

title: Social Media Managerin / Content Creatorin (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst nicht nur Social Media managen, sondern selbst das Gesicht einer Marke werden?

BuddySIM macht mobiles Internet auf Reisen einfach. Mit unseren eSIMs können Reisende in über 190 Ländern direkt online gehen: 100% ohne Roaming-Stress, SIM-Kartenwechsel oder komplizierte Tarife.

Jetzt wollen wir unsere Marke auf Social Media auf das nächste Level bringen. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Lust hat, vor der Kamera zu stehen, Menschen anzusprechen und gemeinsam mit uns Content zu entwickeln, der auffällt. 

Du wirst eines der Gesichter von BuddySIM auf TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts und weiteren Plattformen.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du stehst regelmäßig selbst vor der Kamera und repräsentierst BuddySIM auf unseren Social-Media-Kanälen.

- Du entwickelst kreative Formate, Reels, TikToks und wiederkehrende Content-Serien.

- Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und führst beispielsweise spontane Interviews, Straßenumfragen oder Reise-Challenges durch.

- Du beobachtest Trends und erkennst früh, welche Formate, Sounds und Themen Potenzial haben.

- Du entwickelst Ideen, Hooks, Storylines und Skripte.

- Du produzierst authentischen Content von der Idee über den Dreh bis zum fertigen Video.

- Du begleitest Events, Reisen, Kooperationen oder Aktionen mit der Kamera.

- Du baust gemeinsam mit uns eine wiedererkennbare Social-Media-Persönlichkeit für BuddySIM auf.

- Du analysierst, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und entwickelst unsere Formate kontinuierlich weiter.

- Du managed Kooperationen mit anderen Creatoren:innen.

Das solltest du mitbringen

Du bist kommunikativ, spontan und kannst Menschen mit deiner Art mitnehmen.

Außerdem wäre ideal, wenn du:

- dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlst und authentisch auftreten kannst,

- offen und selbstbewusst auf fremde Menschen zugehst,

- TikTok, Instagram und aktuelle Social-Media-Trends wirklich verstehst,

- ein gutes Gespür für Humor, Storytelling und interessante Hooks hast,

- kreative Ideen nicht nur vorschlägst, sondern auch direkt umsetzen möchtest,

- eigenständig arbeiten und Verantwortung für eigene Formate übernehmen kannst,

- grundlegende Erfahrung mit Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt mitbringst,

- Lust auf Reisen und internationale Themen hast,

- sehr gutes Deutsch sprichst; Englisch ist ein Plus.

Ein klassischer Lebenslauf oder ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns deutlich weniger wichtig als Persönlichkeit, Kreativität und dein Gefühl für Social Media. 

Was dich bei BuddySIM erwartet

BuddySIM ist ein wachsendes Travel-Tech-Unternehmen aus Deutschland. Wir wollen keine austauschbare Corporate-Kommunikation produzieren, sondern Social Media machen, das Menschen tatsächlich anschauen möchten.

Bei uns bekommst du:

- sehr viel kreativen Freiraum,

- die Möglichkeit, eigene Formate von Grund auf aufzubauen,

- kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Umsetzung,

- direkten Austausch mit dem Gründerteam,

- moderne Tools und Equipment für deine Content-Produktion,

- ein junges, dynamisches Umfeld,

- die Möglichkeit, bei Reisen, Events und besonderen Aktionen dabei zu sein,

- und vor allem die Chance, eine sichtbare Persönlichkeit unserer Marke zu werden. 

Wer perfekt zu uns passt

Vielleicht produzierst du bereits selbst TikToks oder Reels.

Vielleicht bist du die Person in deinem Freundeskreis, die problemlos mit jedem ins Gespräch kommt.

Vielleicht hast du bisher noch nie professionell Social Media gemacht, weißt aber ganz genau, warum manche Videos Millionen Views bekommen und andere niemanden interessieren.

Entscheidend ist für uns nicht dein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Interesse?

Dann schick uns keinen Roman.

Sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und gerne direkt ein kurzes Video, in dem du dich vorstellst.

Bonus: Schick uns eine Idee für ein TikTok oder Reel, das du für BuddySIM drehen würdest.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Vice President (m/f/d) Equity Rebalancing
description:
Company Description

Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!

Job Overview

Are you passionate about capital markets, index investing, and client-facing investment solutions? Do you thrive at the intersection of investment strategy, portfolio construction, and operational excellence in a fast-paced, international environment? We are seeking a highly experienced and client-focused capital markets professional to take ownership of a portfolio of quantitative equity indices while serving as a trusted partner to a global client base. The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of financial markets and quantitative investment strategies with excellent communication and relationship-management skills, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for clients and stakeholders across global markets.

Your Tasks

- Manage and oversee a diverse portfolio of quantitative equity indices, ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all rebalancing activities while maintaining a strong understanding of the underlying investment strategies and client objectives.

- Serve as a senior point of contact for an international client base, including leading investment banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and trading desks, acting as a trusted advisor on index methodologies, rebalancing outcomes, and quantitative investment strategies.

- Lead and coordinate the resolution of client inquiries, escalations, and complex index-related issues, delivering clear, actionable guidance and ensuring a high standard of client service.

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, scalability, and service quality across index management and client support processes.

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Data, Engineering, and Product, to ensure seamless end-to-end delivery and the successful implementation of client requirements.

Your Profile

- Academic degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Financial Mathematics, or Engineering.

- At least 6 years of experience in equity markets execution, portfolio management, index management, or in a similar process-driven financial environment.

- Strong understanding of equity markets, ETFs, index construction, or systematic investment strategies.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Strong sense of ownership, able to operate independently and manage operational responsibility across multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong organizational skills and ability to handle time-sensitive operational workflows.

- Team-oriented with a collaborative mindset and intercultural competence.

- Python skills are an asset.

- Fluency in English.

Our Offer

- Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive.

Who we are

Mantle is the entry point for institutions and traditional finance to access real-world assets on-chain. Backed by the world’s largest community-owned treasury of over $4B, Mantle combines institutional-grade infrastructure with the scale and credibility to bring RWAs into Web3 with confidence.

Mantle positions itself as the gateway for institutions and TradFi to move into RWAs on-chain. With $4B+ in community-owned assets, Mantle combines credibility, liquidity and scale with institutional infrastructure to support large-scale adoption. The ecosystem is anchored by $MNT in the Bybit network, and built out through subsidiaries mETH, fBTC, MI4 and MantleX. This is complemented by Mantle Network’s partnerships with leading issuers and protocols such as Agora AUSD, Ethena USDe, Ondo USDY and EigenLayer.

Your Role

- 
Researching and building blockchain protocols, modules, technologies and algorithms

- 
Preparation of detailed design documents and testing strategies according to requirements

- 
Promoting technical experience sharing within the team

- 
Support the community through the best communications and documentation

Your Craft

- 
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

- 
1–5 years of work experience, with design and development experience in blockchain, distributed systems, or related areas

- 
Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures, with the ability to quickly conduct POC (Proof of Concept) development and validation

- 
Proficient in programming languages such as Go and Rust; highly skilled in smart contract development using Solidity

- 
Extensive experience in cryptography and blockchain, familiar with mainstream blockchain platforms and their core algorithms

- 
Experience contributing to or developing on open-source blockchain projects (e.g., Ethereum, Solana, Optimism) is preferred

- 
Fluent in Bilingual - English and Chinese

职位要求：

- 
计算机科学、软件工程等相关专业，本科及以上学历

- 
1~5年工作年限，区块链、分布式等领域的设计开发经验

- 
精通算法、数据结构，能快速进行POC开发论证

- 
熟练掌握Go、Rust等编程语言，精通智能合约Solidity

- 
在密码学、区块链等领域有丰富经验，熟悉blockchain主流平台及核心算法

- 
对区块链的开源项目（Ethereum、Solana、Optimism...）有开发经验的优先

- 
能快速阅读英文论文与资料，有较强的研究能力和自我驱动力

Extra Credit 

- 
Existing track record of R&D and execution of open source projects on known blockchain platforms such as Ethereum/Cosmos/OP or ZK Rollup is a great plus.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer II
description:
What is Teachable ?

Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it.Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?

Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role? 

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer II, you will be responsible for automating repetitive tasks, streamlining the software development lifecycle, and optimizing deployment processes to enable faster and more reliable software releases. You will analyze existing engineering processes and workflows to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement. With guild insights you will collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement process improvements, optimize code review processes, and implement continuous integration and delivery best practices.

In this position, you will work remotely with Teachable’s Brazil and US-based teams. We are hiring talented engineers in Brazil. 

In this role, you'll: 

- Partner with engineers on the pod and throughout the organization to build high-quality, scalable products

- Create and maintain technical documentation, guidelines, and best practices to ensure knowledge sharing and promote consistent development standards across the organization

- Develop and deliver training programs to onboard new engineers and help them become productive quickly. Provide ongoing training and support to engineers on new technologies, tools, and best practices

- Act as a mentor and provide technical guidance and support to other engineers. Help troubleshoot technical issues, review code, and provide feedback to improve the overall quality of software development

- Constantly “leave it better than how you found it” mentality and are willing to work in and improve legacy code that you did not originally write. 

- Stay up to date with industry trends, new technologies, and best practices in software engineering. Evaluate and recommend new tools, frameworks, and methodologies that can enhance our engineering processes and capabilities

What You’ll Bring: 

- 5+ years of hands-on experience building and supporting production web applications

- Experience utilizing tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and Terraform

- Proficiency writing software used in a production environment

- Experience working on a platform with multiple services

- Excitement and motivation to expand your skillset and take on difficult challenges

- Team player mentality: highly collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings

- A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases

- A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it

- Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects

- Ability to work and problem-solve independently

- A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving

- Advanced English Proficiency

Nice to have: 

- DevOps or SRE experience

- Proficiency in using Golang and Ruby in a production environment

- Experience on an engineering enablement or platform team or experience contributing engineering-wide initiatives

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
About Enode 

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

AI is fundamental to how we work

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

What we're looking for: 

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the team building the software layer that connects EVs, chargers, solar, and batteries, so customers can optimize across fleets of homes and within each home, helping people manage their own energy while participating in grid-scale optimization. That means redesigning for speed, reliability, and broader coverage, evolving from controlling individual devices to optimizing the entire home, driveway included.

AI is raising the bar for engineering leadership, and we need someone who leads people, not just process, who sets a standard the team is proud to clear, and tells leadership what it needs to hear. Our people are our most valuable asset, and we're looking for someone who leads like that. You will:

- Own the team's technical vision end to end, not just execute someone else's roadmap. You partner effectively with the product team to create an ambitious roadmap

- Define what "great" looks like, and refuse to settle for less. Your definition comes from past experiences of seeing great teams succeed

- Sit at the table with the CTO to shape strategy, product bets, and the roadmap for a business area we're still inventing

- Sit on the engineering leadership team, your job doesn't stop at your team's edge

- Lead the charge on AI adoption: find where it changes how we build, ship, and operate, and make it real, not theoretical

- Hire and grow people who make the team sharper, not just bigger. You are a coach to your teammates and help them reach their full potential

- Set expectations that are impossible to misread, then hold people to them with empathy and firmness, in equal measure

- Delegate like you mean it: give your team real ownership, not just tasks

- Push back on me (the CTO), on stakeholders, on plans that don't hold up, and do it in a way that builds trust, not friction

- Build relationships people actually rely on, across engineering, product, and leadership

- Be the person your team and peers come to think out loud with, no judgment, direct feedback both ways.

This role will be right for you, if: 

- 3+ years managing engineers, and you love it!

- You have values you won't compromise, even when it costs you something; tell us what those are!

- You are driven and ambitious, you push for hard goals and hold a high bar for yourself and everyone around you, consistently

- You have good instincts for when to keep it simple and when a clever solution is worth the complexity

- You've led remote, distributed teams and know what holds people together at a distance

- You think past your own team, comfortable shaping decisions at the engineering leadership-team level

- You’ve built AI products that have contributed meaningfully to the team's success

- You do your best work with your stakeholders in the room, not despite them

- Strong opinions, loosely held; you'll fight for a position, and drop it the moment the evidence says you're wrong

- Genuinely interested in the Energy shift, not just management as a craft, but this problem specifically

- Proactive to a fault; you spot the problem before anyone asks you to, and find ways to fix it

- People do better work around you; that's not an accident, it's how you lead and inspire

- You’ve made lots of mistakes in the past and can tell us what that taught you and how it shaped the manager you are today

- Bonus: you've worked across very different environments or company stages, and can tell us what that taught you

- Note: whether you want to stay hands-on as a player-coach or focus fully on management, both are welcome!

What we offer:

- Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

- A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

- Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

- Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

- Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly.

- Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

- Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

- Flexible, human-first culture.

- Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

- Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

- Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here .

title: Enterprise Solutions Architect - Americas
description:
Enterprise Solutions Architect - Americas 

Hi, I’m John and I’m the Head of Professional Services at Ashby . One of my favorite aspects of Ashby is our operating principle of Continuous Improvement . Coupled with our principle of caring deeply about our customers, we often find ourselves wondering ‘what is a better way to accomplish this’. That’s why I am thrilled to be hiring our first Enterprise Solutions Architect! As a highly cross-functional member on our growing Professional Services team (within Ashby’s Customer Success organization), you’ll have the opportunity to start shaping our customers’ journeys before they kick off, ultimately upleveling the overall customer experience. 

About the Role 

As an Enterprise Solutions Architect (SA), you will have responsibility for implementation and services scoping and design, as well as Statement of Work creation to capture recommendations. The SA is a member of the Professional Services (PS) organization and a close partner to the Enterprise Sales team. Broadly, the goal of this role is to ensure the success of Enterprise customers through professional services.

You will work directly with prospective customers and our Solutions Engineering team during the sales cycle to understand the current state, define a clear path to success, and shape both the deal and implementation approach accordingly. You will provide continuity between what was sold and what is delivered by ensuring a comprehensive handoff from Sales to PS.

This is a high-impact, highly cross-functional role focused on aligning pre-sales motions with implementation work to improve Enterprise sales win rates, accelerate time-to-value, and drive long-term customer outcomes. You will play a critical role in matching prospective customers with the approaches that best meet their needs, while helping Sales win complex deals by increasing buyer confidence and reducing perceived implementation risk.

What You’ll Do 

Design and Close Successful Professional Services Opportunities (Pre-Sales) 

- Act as a trusted advisor to help prospective customers understand how to successfully implement Ashby

- Partner with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to scope and design implementation approaches for complex enterprise opportunities

- Translate prospective customer needs and constraints into a tailored path to go-live, including an implementation strategy, success milestones, and services offerings required to support the customer

- Align customer stakeholders (including executives) on desired outcomes, timelines, and responsibilities

- Create, negotiate, and execute Statements of Work (SOWs) aligned with Professional Services best practices and offerings that accurately the required scope, effort, and sequencing

Create Continuity into Delivery (Post-Sales / Early Lifecycle) 

- Participate in the Sales handoff to ensure effective transition of recommendations and expectations to the post-sales team

- Ensure alignment between pre-sales commitments and post-sales execution by participating in kickoff calls for customers with complex or highly custom recommended approaches

Improve Professional Services GTM Motions 

- Identify patterns across opportunities (what works, what breaks) and use these to refine our Enterprise Sales motion in partnership with Leadership.

- Refine how and when services are introduced and scoped within the sales cycle

- Contribute to playbooks, frameworks, and assets that improve how we sell and deliver services

What We’re Looking For 

- 5+ years of experience in Enterprise SaaS across one or more of: Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, or Management Consulting

- Strong ability to diagnose business processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions

- Experience with complex, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful implementation components

- Comfort navigating collaboration with both pre-sales and post-sales teams

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence executives and align cross-functional teams

- Strong judgment and ability to balance customer needs, business outcomes, and operational feasibility

What Success Looks Like 

- Increasing win rates, especially in the Enterprise

- Clear alignment between scope, expectations, and customer outcomes

- Reduced implementation friction and faster time-to-value

- Improved customer confidence and sentiment at kickoff and early lifecycle

- Stronger partnership between Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success

- Increased retention and expansion driven by successful customer outcomes

Why This Role Matters 

As we move upmarket, the complexity of our customers—and the importance of getting implementations just right —continues to increase. This role ensures we are not just closing quickly, but closing them in a way that sets customers up for long-term success.

The Interview 

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety:

- 30 min - Recruiter Screen with Talent Team

- 45 min - Interview with Head of Professional Services (Hiring Manager)

- 45 min - Change Management Challenge

- Final Round Part 1:

- 30 min - Interview with VP of Customer Success

- 30 min - Interview with our Head of Sales Americas & Head of Sales EMEA

- Final Round Part 2:

- 30 min - Interview with CEO

- 10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager

Benefits 

- You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

- You get to sell a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.

- Competitive compensation is offered.

- 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

- Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 

- Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US . We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

- Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

- $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
